 Industry: Garment Manufacturing & Export

JOB SUMMARY The Trims Sourcing Manager will be responsible for end-to-end sourcing, development, costing, negotiation, vendor management, and timely procurement of garment trims and accessories required for sampling and bulk production. The candidate should have strong knowledge of the trims market, a reliable vendor network, excellent negotiation skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with Merchandising, Design, Production, QA, Stores and Accounts. The role requires strong English communication skills , including professional email communication and regular interaction with suppliers and internal teams. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Trims Sourcing & Development Source and develop all types of garment trims and accessories as per buyer, design and production requirements. Handle sourcing of: Labels and care labels Hangtags Buttons and snaps Zippers Elastics Threads Tapes and cords Interlinings Hooks and other closures Embellishments Packaging materials Polybags, cartons and other packing accessories Develop new trims as per approved samples, specifications and buyer requirements. Coordinate sample development and submit trims for approval within the required timeline. Maintain an updated database/library of available trims and suppliers. B. Vendor Development & Management Identify, evaluate and develop reliable new suppliers. Maintain strong relationships with existing vendors. Develop alternate suppliers for critical and frequently used trims. Evaluate vendors based on quality, price, capacity, lead time, reliability and service . Monitor supplier performance and take corrective action wherever required. Maintain a strong and updated vendor database. C. Costing & Negotiation Obtain quotations from multiple suppliers and prepare comparative statements. Negotiate price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, quality and delivery conditions . Ensure competitive sourcing without compromising quality. Monitor market prices and identify cost-saving opportunities. Develop alternate materials/vendors wherever possible for cost optimization. D. Purchase & Order Management Raise/coordinate Purchase Orders as per approved requirements. Ensure all purchase orders clearly mention specifications, quantity, price, delivery date and approved quality standards. Track order status from placement to final delivery. Ensure trims are available as per the production TNA. Escalate potential delays immediately to management and concerned departments. Coordinate with suppliers for urgent and priority requirements. E. Quality & Compliance Ensure trims meet approved specifications, quality standards and buyer requirements. Coordinate with QA/QC for inspection and approval of trims. Resolve quality issues, shortages, damages and discrepancies with suppliers. Ensure applicable buyer-specific testing and compliance requirements are followed. Maintain proper documentation for approvals, test reports and supplier records. F. Internal Coordination Coordinate closely with: Merchandising Design Sampling Production PPC QA/QC Stores Accounts Understand upcoming production and sampling requirements and plan sourcing accordingly. Ensure smooth communication between suppliers and internal departments. Attend meetings related to sourcing, material planning and production requirements. G. MIS & Documentation Maintain updated records of: Supplier database Quotations Cost sheets Comparative statements Purchase Orders Trim approvals Supplier performance Delivery status Pending materials Cost-saving initiatives Prepare regular Trims Sourcing MIS for management. Track pending and delayed materials and highlight critical issues. H. Team Management Lead and guide the trims sourcing team. Allocate work and monitor daily sourcing activities. Ensure timely completion of sampling, costing, vendor development and procurement activities. Train team members on sourcing procedures, vendor management and documentation. Establish systematic sourcing processes and controls. 3. REQUIRED SKILLS Strong knowledge of garment trims and accessories. Strong vendor network in the trims/accessories market. Excellent vendor development and relationship-management skills. Strong costing and price negotiation skills. Good knowledge of garment manufacturing and production processes. Strong understanding of TNA and material planning. Good knowledge of buyer requirements and quality standards. Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/procurement software . Ability to manage multiple suppliers and urgent requirements. Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Excellent English communication skills – mandatory. Should be able to independently draft professional emails to suppliers and internal stakeholders. Good presentation and interpersonal skills. 4. QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE Qualification: 
Graduate / Post Graduate in Textile, Fashion, Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration or a related field. Experience: 6–10 years of relevant experience in trims/accessories sourcing, purchase or procurement in the garment/apparel export industry. Experience with international garment buyers/brands will be preferred. Candidates with an established trims supplier network will be preferred. 5. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPA) Timely availability of trims for sampling and bulk production. Effective price negotiation and cost savings. Successful development of reliable vendors. Supplier quality and performance. On-time trim development and approval. On-time delivery as per production TNA. Reduction in material shortages and delays. Development of alternate suppliers. Compliance with buyer specifications and quality requirements. Accurate sourcing MIS and documentation. Effective coordination with Merchandising, Production, QA, Stores and Accounts. 6. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES Proactive and responsible. Strong ownership of work. Excellent negotiation and communication skills. Good commercial understanding. Detail-oriented and organized. Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Strong relationship-building ability. Solution-oriented approach. Willingness to take ownership of urgent production requirements. title: Senior Staff Engineer, Layout Design
description:
We are seeking a Senior Staff Layout Design Engineer with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal layout for power and analog IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgment, and the ability to lead layout execution for complex blocks and full-chip designs. The successful candidate will translate circuit requirements into robust, manufacturable layouts for products such as PMICs, linear and switching regulators, gate drivers, battery-management ICs, and other power and analog devices. The role requires close collaboration with analog designers, CAD, process, package, reliability, and verification teams. You will be expected to own challenging layout problems, establish best practices, improve methodology and automation, mentor engineers, and drive projects from floor planning through physical verification and tape-out readiness. Responsibilities Layout Architecture & Execution Own floor planning and physical implementation for complex analog, power, and mixed-signal blocks, and contribute to full-chip layout planning. Collaborate with circuit designers to capture electrical, matching, isolation, current-density, thermal, reliability, and area requirements. Apply advanced layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, noise isolation, high-current routing, electromigration robustness, thermal behavior, and yield optimization. Drive routing, integration, and sign-off readiness for block-level and chip-level layouts. Physical Verification & Sign-off Own and review DRC, LVS, ERC, PEX, antenna, density, latch-up, and reliability verification as required by the process and product. Analyse extracted parasitics with designers and support post-layout simulation closure. Identify physical-design risks early and drive corrective actions with design, CAD, PDK, process, and package teams. Ensure layout databases, review records, and release documentation meet tape-out quality standards. Methodology, Automation & IP Reuse Develop and deploy automation using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar languages to improve quality and turnaround time. Drive layout methodology improvements, reusable templates, checklists, and portability of IP across products and process technologies. Work with corporate engineering and CAD teams to resolve tool, PDK, extraction, and process-flow issues. Evaluate new layout tools and techniques and lead practical adoption within the team. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Lead layout reviews and provide clear estimates, progress updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans. Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers and raise the technical standard of the broader team. Influence project planning, task allocation, technical decisions, and hiring through demonstrated technical depth. Operate independently on ambiguous and complex assignments, escalating issues with clear options and recommendations. Qualifications Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in analog, power, or mixed-signal IC layout and associated development flows. Demonstrated ownership of complex block-level layout and meaningful contribution to full-chip integration and tape-out. Deep understanding of matching, parasitic control, noise isolation, guard rings, latch-up prevention, high-current routing, electromigration, IR drop, thermal effects, and reliability-aware layout. Hands-on expertise with Cadence Virtuoso and physical verification tools such as Calibre, PVS, or equivalent. Experience with extraction and reliability tools is expected. Experience working with deep-submicron CMOS and preferably BCD or high-voltage process technologies. Ability to automate layout or verification tasks using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages. Proven ability to lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and drive layout methodology improvements. Strong cross-functional communication skills in a multisite and multicultural environment. Results-oriented, self-driven, and able to deliver high-quality work under tight schedules with limited supervision.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Radar Systems team. You will be responsible for the end-to-end mechanical design and integration of radar subsystems and enclosures. The role is critical to ensuring structural integrity, thermal performance, environmental compliance, and manufacturability of complex radar systems deployed in airborne, naval, or ground-based platforms. 
 Key Responsibilites 
 Design and develop mechanical components, structures, and enclosures for radar systems, including RF shielding and modular electronics packaging. Work closelywith electrical, RF, and systemengineers to ensuretight integration of mechanical and electronic components. Conduct thermal,structural, and vibrationanalysis (FEA/CFD) to meet militaryand industrial environmental standards (MIL-STD, IPxx, DO-160). Generate detailed3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings,and BOMs using tools like SolidWorks, Creo, or Siemens NX. Drive DFM/DFAconsiderations from conceptto production for in-house or vendor-based manufacturing. Evaluate materials for EMI/EMC shielding, thermal management, and weight reduction. Oversee mechanical prototyping, environmental testing, and qualification activities. Interface with suppliers and fabrication partnersto ensure timely delivery of high-quality components. Contribute to technical documentation, compliance reviews, and internal design reviews. Required Qualifications Bachelors or Mastersdegree in Mechanical Engineering or relatedfield. 0-2 years of experience in mechanical design for aerospace, defense, or high-reliability electronics systems. Proficient in 3D CAD software(SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent). Hands-on experience with FEA tools(ANSYS, Abaqus) and thermal simulation (FloTHERM, Icepak). Knowledge of radar systems, RF enclosures, and EMI/EMC best practices. Familiarity with IP, MIL-STD-810G, MIL-STD-461, or similar ruggedization standards. Strong understanding of materials engineering for harsh environments (aluminum alloys, composites, thermal interfaces). Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with airborne,naval & ground radar systems or similar rugged embedded platforms. Knowledge of radarcooling systems (conduction, forced air, liquidcooling). Exposure to additive manufacturing or advanced composites. Experience in GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and technically competent Project Manager NDT to manage and coordinate NDT project activities and support the successful execution of projects across various locations. The ideal candidate should have 510 years of experience in NDT/Inspection, preferably from the Oil & Gas, Refinery, Petrochemical, Pipeline, EPC or Industrial Inspection industry. Candidates with strong experience in PAUT/UT and advanced NDT techniques are mandatorily required. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating project execution, manpower, equipment, technical activities, documentation, customer communication and project deliverables. The role requires an individual who can understand both the technical and business aspects of a project, effectively use relevant tools and software, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and take ownership and accountability for project execution. The selected candidate will be required to develop an understanding of VIPL's NDT systems, equipment and build railway-specific data tools and applications. This candidate will work closely with Field Service Technicians and project teams for execution of projects involving Indian Railways and Metro organisations. Railway experience is not mandatory. Candidates from the Oil & Gas and related NDT industries with strong project execution experience are encouraged to apply. The company may entrust you with additional job responsibilities from time to time. 
 Role & responsibilities NDT Project Management & Execution Plan, coordinate and execute NDT projects from initiation through completion. Understand project scope, technical requirements, timelines, deliverables and customer expectations. Take ownership and accountability for assigned projects and ensure timely completion. Prepare project execution plans, schedules and activity trackers. Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and deliverables. Identify project risks, delays and operational challenges and take corrective action. Ensure smooth coordination between technical, field and management teams. Support management in achieving project objectives within defined timelines and resources. 
 NDT Technical Coordination Develop and maintain a strong understanding of NDT techniques, procedures, equipment and applications. Coordinate NDT inspection activities and ensure execution as per approved procedures and customer requirements. Coordinate PAUT/NDT data acquisition, analysis, interpretation and reporting. Develop and maintain internal company data validation, analysis and interpretation tools and applications for customer. Review technical reports and inspection documentation for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with technical teams for troubleshooting and resolution of site-level technical issues. Ensure appropriate use and deployment of NDT equipment and inspection systems. 
 Manpower & Resource Management Plan and coordinate deployment of NDT engineers, technicians and other project personnel. Assess manpower requirements based on project scope and schedules. Coordinate allocation and mobilisation of NDT equipment, tools and other resources. Monitor manpower utilisation and project resource requirements. Ensure timely mobilisation of personnel and equipment at project sites. Coordinate with Field Service Engineers and site teams to resolve operational requirements. Monitor team performance and identify operational gaps. Support training and knowledge-sharing within the project team. 
 Customer & Stakeholder Management Act as a point of coordination between customers, project teams and internal management. Understand customer requirements and ensure timely communication and execution. Participate in customer meetings, project discussions and review meetings. Coordinate with vendors, OEM partners, technology partners and other stakeholders as required. 
 Project Monitoring, MIS & Reporting Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly project reports. Maintain project trackers covering manpower, equipment, activities, timelines and deliverables. Raising and realisation of bills and invoices with the customers upon completion of project milestones. Monitor project performance and highlight deviations to management. Prepare MIS and management presentations using MS Excel and PowerPoint. Maintain proper records of project activities, inspection data and customer deliverables. 
 Business System & Process Management Develop a thorough understanding of VIPL's business processes, project workflow and operational systems. Assist in developing and improving systems, processes and frameworks for efficient project execution. Identify opportunities for improving project efficiency, productivity and resource utilisation. 
 Quality, Safety & Compliance Ensure NDT activities are carried out as per applicable procedures, standards and customer specifications. Support quality reviews, audits and corrective actions wherever required. Ensure appropriate handling, maintenance and utilisation of NDT equipment. 
 Additional Responsibilities. Support new project implementation and technology deployment. Undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the management from time to time. 
 Preferred candidate profile 510 years of experience in NDT, inspection or related project execution. ASNT Level II certification in NDT is required. PAUT/UT certification and practical experience will be strongly preferred. Candidates from Oil & Gas, Refinery, Petrochemical, Pipeline, EPC and Industrial Inspection backgrounds are preferred. Experience in handling or coordinating NDT projects is required/preferred. Experience in project planning, execution, manpower coordination and resource management will be preferred. Should have experience dealing with customer (government) and multiple stakeholders. Should have a good understanding of inspection activities, data interpretation and technical reporting. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required. Experience in preparing MIS, project reports, trackers and presentations. Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Verbal and written communication skills in Hindi, English and a regional language is preferred. Should be willing to travel extensively across India. Should be flexible to work extended hours whenever project requirements demand. Strong ownership and accountability towards project deliverables. Should be comfortable working in a field-oriented environment. Should be willing to learn new technologies, systems and railway-specific applications. Candidates willing to transition from industries like Oil & Gas, etc. to Railway/Metro projects are encouraged to apply. Delhi/NCR-based candidates will be preferred. Job Benefits & Perks As per industry standards and rules and regulations promulgated by the Government from time to time.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
The GTM Engineer owns the architecture and health of Quisitive's marketing execution engine: the platforms, integrations, automation logic, and data models that turn GTM strategy into a repeatable, scalable flywheel. This role goes beyond configuring out-of-the-box marketing automation features - it requires connecting systems together via APIs, custom connectors, and webhook-based integrations; building custom workflows and automations (e.g., using Power Automate); and building and managing AI-driven agents that extend what the platforms can do natively. "Agentic workflows" here means creating agents using low-code tools like Copilot Studio, orchestrating workflows within ZoomInfo Marketing, and building other automations using Power Platform, Zapier, or similar solutions, rather than custom-coded, general-purpose AI development. This is a systems-thinking and integration-building role, not a data-engineering one: it does not require Python, SQL, or Clay-style scripting. What it does require is curiosity - the instinct to ask "why does this work this way" and "where will this break at 10x volume," and the technical range to actually go build the fix. 
 Qualifications Required 5+ years in marketing operations/RevOps with a focus on systems and automation architecture, not just execution Hands-on experience building workflows/automations in Power Automate (or similar), including the use of custom connectors and webhook-based integrations to connect systems that don't natively talk to each other Experience connecting systems via APIs, custom connectors, or webhooks (native or custom-built) - beyond just using pre-built, out-of-the-box integrations Experience building AI agents using low-code tools such as Copilot Studio, and orchestrating automated workflows across platforms like ZoomInfo Marketing, Power Platform, Zapier, or similar solutions Demonstrated experience designing - not just running - impactful B2B lead scoring, segmentation models, and trigger-based workflows Strong systems-thinking mindset: comfortable questioning why a process works the way it does, and identifying where it will break at scale Experience with CRM/marketing automation integrations and platform migrations Preferred Dynamics 365 Marketing (Customer Insights Journeys), Dynamics 365 CRM Power BI or similar reporting/BI tools Account based marketing systems such as 6Sense or ZoomInfo Marketing Experience leading a platform migration or stack consolidation Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio), plus Zapier or similar workflow automation tools Not Required Python, SQL, Clay, or general-purpose software development - this role is about systems integration, workflow/agent building, and architecture thinking, not data engineering Success Metrics Automation maturity (% of campaigns running on triggers/agents vs. manual builds) Pipeline contribution from automated programs Number and business impact of systems successfully integrated via API/workflow automation Attribution accuracy and reporting reliability Reduction in manual processes across the team

title: Electrical Maintenance Technician
description:
We are looking for a skilled and certified Electrical Maintenance Technician with a valid C-Licence to join our Engineering team. The role is responsible for the safe and reliable operation, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and troubleshooting of plant electrical systems, covering equipment from HT yards to production machinery . The position will also play a key role in ensuring statutory compliance, electrical safety, and adherence to applicable state electrical regulations , including validation and certification of electrical installations and modifications. Key Responsibilities 1. Electrical Operations & Maintenance Execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of electrical equipment, including: Transformers HT/LT panels MCC/PCC panels VCB/ACB circuit breakers Motors and associated control systems Diagnose and resolve complex electrical faults in: Motors Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) Control circuits and instrumentation interfaces Read and interpret electrical schematics, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring diagrams, and engineering drawings for troubleshooting and installation activities. Monitor and ensure reliable operation of utility equipment such as Diesel Generator (DG) sets, air compressors, and associated electrical systems . Monitor plant power quality and maintain Power Factor (PF) close to unity through effective operation and maintenance of APFC panels. Coordinate with production and other engineering functions to minimize electrical downtime and ensure uninterrupted plant operations. 2. Statutory Compliance & Licensing Act as the designated C-Licence holder and undertake responsibilities related to electrical installations and modifications within the scope permitted under applicable regulations. Ensure electrical maintenance and installation activities comply with applicable state electricity regulations, electrical safety standards, and statutory requirements . Coordinate with the State Electricity Board and Electrical Inspectorate for inspections, audits, load sanctions, approvals, and licence-related requirements. Maintain statutory records and documentation, including: Electrical inspection records Earth-pit testing records Statutory registers Relevant Form F/H submissions Electrical equipment testing and certification records Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of applicable electrical licences, certificates, and statutory approvals. 3. Electrical Safety Implement and strictly enforce Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during electrical maintenance activities. Ensure compliance with Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems for electrical work. Conduct regular inspections of electrical installations, panels, cable systems, earthing systems, and electrical rooms to identify potential safety hazards. Ensure appropriate PPE and safe working practices are followed during electrical maintenance and troubleshooting. Support electrical safety audits, risk assessments, and corrective action implementation. 4. Reliability & Continuous Improvement Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring electrical failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, reduce breakdowns, and minimize electrical-related production downtime. Monitor maintenance performance indicators such as MTBF, MTTR, breakdown frequency, and maintenance compliance . Maintain proper maintenance records and ensure timely closure of maintenance activities. Drive 5S and good housekeeping practices in electrical rooms, workshops, and plant utility areas. Participate in energy conservation and electrical efficiency improvement initiatives. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HT/LT electrical systems and industrial electrical maintenance . Hands-on experience with transformers, HT/LT panels, MCC/PCC, VCB/ACB, motors, VFDs, and control circuits. Knowledge of PLC-based control systems and industrial automation. Ability to read and interpret SLDs, electrical drawings, and wiring diagrams . Good understanding of electrical safety, LOTO, PTW, earthing, and statutory compliance . Knowledge of DG sets, compressors, APFC panels, and plant utilities. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a manufacturing/plant environment. Good coordination and communication skills. Educational Qualification Diploma / ITI in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent. A valid and relevant C-Licence is mandatory . Additional electrical safety certifications will be an advantage. Experience 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in industrial/manufacturing electrical maintenance . Candidates with hands-on experience in HT/LT systems, plant maintenance, electrical statutory compliance, and troubleshooting will be preferred. Key Performance Areas (KPIs) Electrical equipment availability and reliability Reduction in electrical breakdowns and downtime Preventive maintenance compliance Improvement in MTBF and reduction in MTTR Power Factor and energy efficiency Statutory compliance and timely documentation Electrical safety and LOTO/PTW compliance 5S and housekeeping standards Timely completion of corrective and preventive maintenance activities

Key Skills: Electrical Maintenance,Operation Maintenance,Preventive Maintenance,Operations,Electricals,Preventive,Maintenance

description:
Job Title Job Title: Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager Job Summary The Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager is a critical role responsible for managing and resolving high-impact incidents that affect the services and operations of our organization. The individual in this position will be expected to lead and coordinate the response to major incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations and maintaining communication with all stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in IT service management, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to work under pressure. The Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager is a vital role that requires a dedicated professional capable of navigating high-stress situations and delivering results. If you have the experience, skills, and certifications required, and are ready to take on this challenging yet rewarding position, we encourage you to apply. Responsibilities Lead the process of incident management from detection to resolution and post-incident review. Coordinate with IT teams, business units, and external vendors to manage major incidents effectively. Communicate effectively with all levels of management and stakeholders during major incidents. Write high quality incident/outage communications with zero defect. Ensure that all incidents are logged, tracked, and documented in accordance with EY's Incident Management policies and procedures. Develop and maintain the Major Incident Management Plan and ensure it is followed during incidents. Conduct post-incident analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences. Excellent collaborator with people at all levels to solve high impact incidents within agreed SLA for Major Incidents. Ability to escalate and engage support resources based on established EY's Major Incident Management process. Knowledge and Skills Requirements 10+ years of industry experience in a Major Incident Management or Outage Management role. Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and practices. Proven track record of successfully managing and resolving major incidents in a complex IT environment. Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices. Good understanding of ServiceNow Incident and Major Incident Management module. Supervision Responsibilities No direct supervision responsibilities, but demonstrable ability to lead bridge calls related to high-impact incidents and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, with the aim of restoring services as soon as possible. Other Requirements Mandatory qualifying criterion: Candidates must be willing and able to work in a 24x7 rotating shift model, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays. This is a Kochi-based role and requires working from the office only. Willingness to be on-call to respond to high-priority incidents as they occur. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Experience At least 10 years of relevant experience in Major Incident Management or a similar role within the IT industry. Certification Requirements ITIL Foundation certification required; intermediate ITIL certification preferred.

title: General Manager Operations and Business Development
description:
Role Overview 
 The General Manager Operations & Business Development will be responsible for the overall coordination and supervision of the companys day-to-day office operations. The selected candidate will allocate responsibilities to employees, monitor the progress of important assignments, coordinate between different departments and ensure that tasks are completed within the required timelines. In addition to internal office management, the candidate will represent NR Marines LLP in meetings with customers, government departments, shipyards, maritime organisations, OEMs, business partners and other stakeholders. The candidate will also be responsible for identifying new opportunities, developing professional relationships and supporting the expansion of the company’s business. This is a hands-on leadership position and not merely an advisory or administrative role. The candidate must be willing and able to manage the office while also travelling for meetings, customer visits and business-development activities. 
 Key Responsibilities Office Operations and Administration 
 Manage and supervise the day-to-day functioning of the office. Allocate responsibilities to employees according to their capabilities and organisational priorities. Monitor the progress of assigned work and ensure timely completion. Establish effective systems for reporting, follow-up and accountability. Conduct regular reviews with team members regarding pending and priority matters. Coordinate between tendering, procurement, engineering, logistics, accounts, documentation and service-support functions. Monitor important correspondence, enquiries, tenders, purchase orders, inspections, dispatches, payments and project deadlines. Ensure that customer requirements and management instructions are properly communicated and implemented. Identify operational delays or bottlenecks and take timely corrective action. Maintain professional discipline, punctuality and accountability within the office. Handle urgent, sensitive or challenging situations confidently and practically. Provide regular operational updates and reports to the management. Team Leadership and Supervision Lead, guide and supervise office personnel. Ensure proper allocation of work and clarity of individual responsibilities. Improve coordination between employees and departments. Review employee performance and identify areas requiring improvement. Motivate team members and encourage responsibility and ownership. Train junior employees in professional communication, customer handling, follow-up and documentation. Ensure that important matters are followed up consistently and do not remain unattended. Promote a professional, disciplined and result-oriented working environment. Act as a dependable senior point of contact for both employees and external stakeholders. 
 Business Development and Expansion 
 Identify new business opportunities in the marine, shipbuilding, government, industrial and engineering sectors. Develop and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers. Meet representatives of shipyards, government departments, maritime organisations, OEMs, consultants and private-sector companies. Represent NR Marines LLP during customer meetings, commercial discussions, exhibitions, conferences and industry events. Conduct regular visits to customers, project locations and partner organisations. Follow up on enquiries, proposals, tenders and ongoing commercial opportunities. Support the management in developing and implementing business-growth strategies. Identify new products, markets, OEMs, technology partners and business associates. Assist in commercial negotiations and support the conversion of opportunities into confirmed orders. Monitor upcoming projects, procurement plans, market developments and competitor activities. Maintain a structured record of leads, meetings, enquiries and business opportunities. Submit periodic reports on customer engagement, business-development activities and expected order conversions. Help expand the company’s presence across relevant government and private-sector markets. 
 Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be a mature, dependable and energetic professional with a strong personality and leadership presence. The candidate must possess: Excellent spoken and written English communication skills. Strong confidence, interpersonal skills and professional presentation. Proven ability to lead teams, allocate responsibilities and monitor performance. Ability to communicate comfortably with senior government officials, defence personnel, shipyard representatives, business owners and technical professionals. Strong administrative, organisational and follow-up capabilities. Commercial awareness and a genuine interest in business development. Ability to conduct meetings and negotiations independently. Ability to handle difficult situations calmly and take practical decisions. Good working knowledge of email communication, Microsoft Office, presentations and reporting systems. Willingness to travel for customer meetings, project coordination and business-development activities. High standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional conduct. A hands-on, solution-oriented and result-driven approach. 
 Preferred Professional Background 
 Preference will be given to candidates having experience in one or more of the following areas: Retired Commissioned Officer from the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, Indian Army or Indian Air Force. Retired defence personnel with experience in administration, operations, logistics, procurement, engineering, maintenance or commercial coordination. Merchant Navy Captain, Chief Engineer, Marine Engineer or other experienced maritime professional seeking a shore-based leadership role. Senior professional from a shipyard, marine-equipment company, engineering organisation, government contractor or industrial organisation. Professional with established contacts in the marine, shipbuilding, government or industrial sectors. A marine, naval or merchant-navy background will be a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Candidates from other professional backgrounds may also be considered if they possess excellent leadership, office-management and business-development capabilities. Educational Qualifications Graduate in any discipline from a recognised university or institution. Qualifications in Engineering, Marine Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, Logistics or Management will be preferred. Candidates with substantial defence, maritime or leadership experience may be considered based on their overall professional credentials. 
 Experience Requirements 
 Minimum 15 years of overall professional experience. Experience in team leadership, office administration, operations, customer coordination or business development is essential. Previous exposure to government organisations, shipyards, marine companies, engineering firms or institutional customers will be preferred. Retired defence officers and experienced merchant-navy professionals transitioning into a shore-based leadership position are encouraged to apply. 
 Key Performance Areas 
 The candidate’s performance will be assessed primarily on: Efficiency and discipline of office operations. Timely allocation and completion of work. Improvement in internal coordination and accountability. Effective monitoring of tenders, orders, inspections, dispatches and payments. Quality and frequency of customer engagement. Identification and development of new business opportunities. Conversion of leads into enquiries, tenders and confirmed orders. Expansion of the company’s customer and partner network. Effective resolution of operational and customer-related matters. 
 What We Offer 
 A senior leadership position with direct access to the management. Responsibility and authority to improve office systems and team performance. An opportunity to contribute directly to the growth and expansion of NR Marines LLP. Exposure to marine, shipbuilding, government and specialised engineering projects. A professional role combining operations, leadership, customer engagement and business development. Remuneration based on the candidate’s experience, professional background and capabilities. 
 Application Requirements 
 Interested candidates should apply with an updated CV and provide the following information: Current location. Present and expected remuneration. Notice period or earliest joining date. Details of defence, maritime, shipyard, government or industrial experience, if applicable. Brief description of team-management and business-development experience. Willingness to travel for customer meetings and official assignments.

title: Motion & Illustration Designer - Product| 3-5 yrs exp | Bangalore |
description:
Were looking for a Motion & Illustration Designer to join our Product Design team and help us create engaging, intuitive, and delightful product experiences. 
 The Role : 
As a Motion & Illustration Designer within the Product Design team, you will work closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, and Engineers to bring product experiences to life through motion, illustration, animation, and visual storytelling. You will play a key role in making products more expressive and intuitive from micro-interactions and onboarding experiences to illustrations, empty states, feature education, and complex product flows. Were looking for someone who understands that motion and illustration are not just decorative elements, but powerful tools to communicate, guide, simplify, and enhance the user experience.
 What Youll Do 
 Partner closely with Product Designers and Product Managers from the early stages of product discovery and ideation.
 Create motion concepts, animations, and micro-interactions for consumer and supply products.
 Bring UI designs to life through meaningful transitions, interactions, feedback states, and animations.
 Create illustrations, icons, characters, and visual assets for product experiences.
 Design illustrations and motion for onboarding, empty states, error states, success states, feature discovery, education, and engagement.
 Develop visual solutions for complex product problems and make them easier for users to understand.
 Create motion prototypes to help Product Designers communicate interaction ideas before development.
 Collaborate with Engineers to ensure animations and interactions are implemented effectively and maintain design intent.
 Build and maintain reusable motion and illustration components, patterns, and guidelines for the Product Design team.
 Explore new interaction and visual design patterns that can improve the overall product experience.
 Participate in design critiques and contribute to raising the motion, illustration, and visual craft bar across the Product Design team.
 Balance creativity with product constraints, usability, performance, and technical feasibility.
 What Were Looking For 
 3-5 years of experience in Motion Design, Product Design, Visual Design, Illustration, or a related field.
 Strong portfolio demonstrating motion + illustration work specifically for digital products/apps.
 Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, interaction design, visual hierarchy, composition, typography, and storytelling.
 Strong illustration skills with the ability to develop original visual styles and assets.
 Experience designing micro-interactions, UI animations, transitions, and product motion.
 Proficiency in tools such as Figma, After Effects, Illustrator, or equivalent tools.
 Experience collaborating closely with Product Designers and Engineers.
 Ability to think beyond individual screens and understand how motion and illustration contribute to the overall product experience.
 Strong attention to detail and a high bar for craft.
 Ability to take an ambiguous product problem and translate it into a clear visual or motion solution.
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative product environment.
 Good to Have 
 Experience with Lottie, Rive, ProtoPie, Principle, or similar interaction/motion tools.
 Experience creating animations for mobile applications.
 Understanding of motion performance and implementation constraints on mobile/web.
 Experience with design systems and reusable motion/visual components.
 Basic knowledge of 3D or character animation.
 Experience working in a consumer-tech or product startup. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Motion becomes a meaningful part of product experience, not just an embellishment.
 Users understand complex product flows faster through visual storytelling and motion.
 We develops a distinctive and consistent illustration and motion language across its products.
 Product Designers are able to prototype and communicate richer interactions effectively.
 The quality and craft of motion, illustration, and interaction design across the Product Design team continues to improve.
 Who Youll Work With 
Youll be part of the Product Design team and work closely with:
Product Designers Product Managers Engineers Research & Data teams Your primary focus will be on product experiences, with occasional collaboration with Brand/Marketing when product-led visual assets are required.
 What We Value 
Craft. Curiosity. Product thinking. Attention to detail. Experimentation.
Were looking for someone who can combine the craft of an illustrator and motion designer with the mindset of a product designer.

title: Senior Graphic Designer & Motion Content Designer
description:
About the company: Swazei is a US-based remote software product experience company headquartered in San Diego, California. We are a team of technology enthusiasts from all over the world, committed to making things possible. Passionate about executing products with agile, lean processes, we strive to create product experiences that drive results. Our global ecosystem of talent and agile design and development processes help us deliver software that brings value to our clients. Visit our website. 
 About the Project: A2Z POS builds the point-of-sale and retail operations platform for independent liquor stores and neighborhood markets. We are a founder-led company in final MVP (Minimum Viable Product) testing and preparing to onboard our first early adopters. We are looking for a senior designer who is equally strong in static design and in motion, to own the visual execution of our marketing. This is our first dedicated creative hire: you will build the brand system, the asset library, and the templates the company works from rather than executing someone else's. You will also direct the creative output of one direct report, our Marketing & SEO Specialist, who owns search, content, and website publishing. 
 Key Responsibilities Brand system. Own and evolve the A2Z POS visual identity across website, social media, campaigns, video, and sales collateral. Build a documented design system and a reusable template library in Figma and Canva that non-designers can work from, and keep an organized, versioned asset library in company storage. Social and campaign design. Design social posts, carousels, banners, paid-ad creative, and campaign graphics for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other digital channels, adapting each across formats without losing quality. Video and short-form content. Produce Reels, Shorts, product videos, and promotional spots from raw capture or screen recording through final delivery. Motion graphics. Create animated typography, transitions, UI (user interface) animation, product animation, and brand/logo animation. Product explainers. Produce walkthroughs, feature explainers, and tutorial videos that make POS (point-of-sale) and back-office workflows easy to follow for a store owner with no software background. Marketing collateral. Design brochures, flyers, one-pagers, presentations, sales collateral, and infographics for the early-adopter sales effort. Website and conversion. Design and improve website page layouts, landing pages, and visual hierarchy, and deliver web-ready assets to specification partnering with the Marketing & SEO Specialist, who owns on-page search and backend publishing. Creative direction. Develop concepts, mood boards, and creative directions for campaigns, and translate product features and business messages into clear visual stories. Team direction. Brief, review, and develop the creative output of one direct report, and hold the brand quality line before anything publishes. 
 Required Qualifications 5+ years of professional experience in graphic design, visual design, motion design, or a closely related role. Exceptional portfolios below this threshold will be considered the work is the gate, not the tenure. Strength in both static and motion at a professional standard. This role requires both; a strong static portfolio with weak motion work, or the reverse, will not clear screening. Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects. Strong working proficiency in Figma. Proven experience creating marketing creative for digital and social channels, and for product demos, SaaS explainers, and UI animation. Strong command of typography, colour theory, layout, composition, visual hierarchy, and branding — able to explain design decisions, not only make them. Practical AI-assisted creative workflow. Working use of AI image, video, and motion tools, with judgment about where AI output is acceptable in customer-facing brand work and where it is not. Be ready to walk through one piece of work where AI changed how you produced it. Ability to take a project from concept to final production independently, including asking the right clarifying questions up front. Strong written English, time management, and disciplined asynchronous communication across a 12.5-hour time difference. Preferred: SaaS, B2B (business-to-business), software, startup, or digital-product brands; experience as the first or only designer at an early-stage company; experience directing another designer.

title: Marketing Assistant - Gurgaon
description:
Marketing Specialist - Electrophysiology Role Overview The Marketing Specialist will coordinate and execute day-to-day marketing activities for the Electrophysiology business, translating marketing plans into timely, compliant, and high-quality deliverables. The role will own campaign and content coordination, educational-program execution, agency and vendor management, marketing operations, budget tracking, data reporting, and documentation across offline and digital channels. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and external partners, the candidate will maintain execution discipline, brand consistency, stakeholder alignment, and closure of agreed actions. Key Responsibilities Marketing Planning, Operations & Coordination - Coordinate the day-to-day execution of approved marketing plans, campaigns, product launches, educational initiatives, and internal communications. - Build and maintain annual and monthly marketing calendars, campaign workbacks, activity trackers, risk logs, and project timelines. - Serve as the coordination point for Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Procurement, agencies, and vendors. - Track dependencies, escalate execution risks early, and drive agreed actions to closure within approved timelines and budgets. - Manage marketing requests, briefs, approval status, asset versions, distribution readiness, and activity closure documentation. - Identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to increase execution speed, visibility, and accountability. Campaigns, Product Launches & Market Development - Coordinate with vendors for timely follow-ups and revisions based on the briefs provided to them. - Coordinate campaign assets and activation across email, digital,field communication, conferences, workshops, and physician-education programs. - Support new-product introductions through launch trackers, asset readiness, internal communication, field enablement materials, and post-launch performance updates. - Collate market, customer, competitor, event, and channel inputs and convert them into structured summaries and actionable marketing recommendations. - Conduct post-activity reviews, document lessons learned, and recommend improvements for future campaigns and programs. Content, Brand & Promotional Compliance - Proofread, and coordinate for invitations, flyers, presentations, social-media content, internal communications, videos, and field-facing materials. - Maintain a controlled library of approved assets, source files, claims, references, image permissions, expiry dates, and version history. - Ensure materials follow approved brand standards, intended-use requirements, review workflows, and applicable healthcare-compliance processes before release. Educational Programs, Events & Stakeholder Engagement - Coordinate for CMEs, webinars, workshops, roadshows, congress activities, physician programs, and internal marketing meetings from planning through closure. - Maintain agendas, invitations, registrations, participant lists, faculty requirements, venue and vendor coordination, materials, and run-of-show documents. - Track approvals, documentation, attendance, feedback, photographs, expenses, and post-event reports for timely and complete closure. - Maintain a forward calendar of conferences, scientific programs, launch milestones, and key customer-engagement opportunities. Data, Insights & Performance Reporting - Maintain accurate marketing databases, customer and stakeholder lists, event records, campaign data, activity trackers, and documentation repositories. - Prepare monthly and quarterly dashboards covering activity status, campaign performance, event outcomes, budget status, risks, and next actions. - Consolidate quantitative and qualitative feedback and highlight trends, gaps, and opportunities for marketing decision-making. - Ensure data quality, confidentiality, appropriate access, and timely correction of inaccurate or incomplete records. Budget, Vendor & Marketing Administration Track approved marketing budgets, purchase orders, invoices, commitments, accrual inputs, and spend against plan. Coordinate vendor onboarding, estimates, scopes, timelines, deliverable acceptance, and payment documentation. Maintain inventory and dispatch records for approved marketing materials and flag replenishment or obsolescence risks. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action trackers, and concise status updates for routine marketing governance. Electrophysiology Knowledge The candidate will develop a BASIC working understanding of the Electrophysiology market, customer pathway, and core therapies and technologies, including atrial fibrillation, ablation, pulsed field ablation, and 3D mapping. Prior technical knowledge is advantageous but not mandatory; curiosity, learning agility, and the ability to communicate accurately in a regulated healthcare category are essential. Key Skills & Competencies Strong project coordination, prioritization, organization, and follow-through across multiple workstreams. Clear written and verbal communication with strong proofreading, documentation, and presentation skills. Working proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word; familiarity with Canva, marketing automation, analytics, CRM, or content-management tools is advantageous. Basic understanding of campaign execution, digital channels, social media, event marketing, and performance metrics. High attention to detail, data accuracy, brand consistency, confidentiality, and compliance discipline. Ability to work independently, solve routine execution issues, manage agencies and vendors, and escalate risks appropriately. Proactive, dependable, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Preferred Qualifications - Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field. - 1-3 years of experience in marketing coordination, campaign execution, digital marketing, events, healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a comparable regulated industry. - Demonstrated experience managing timelines, stakeholders, content assets, reporting, or vendor deliverables is preferred. - Experience with digital platforms, design tools, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, or event-management systems would be an advantage. Measures of Success On-time delivery of campaigns, events, assets, reports, and assigned actions. Accuracy and completeness of trackers, databases, budgets, approvals, and closure documentation. description:
About Ethos Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. About the role People Services is where Ethos shows up for its employees every day, and this role leads it. As Manager, People Services, youll lead the team that handles the high-volume, transactional work that keeps the employee lifecycle running, and youll hold it to the highest quality bar. Reporting to the Director, Global People Operations, youll set delivery and quality standards, manage service levels, and make sure every employee interaction is timely, accurate, and genuinely helpful. Because this work is transactional and repeatable by nature, a core part of your role is spotting and prioritizing the workflows that should be automated, then partnering with our People Product Manager to bring those automations to life. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who takes pride in operational excellence and believes a stellar employee experience is built on consistent flawless execution. Duties and Responsibilities: Lead, coach, and develop the People Services team, setting clear goals, managing capacity and workload, and building a high-performing, service-minded culture. Own delivery and quality standards for high-volume transactional People work across the employee lifecycle (onboarding, employee changes, records, offboarding, and employee queries), holding the team to the highest accuracy bar. Define, manage, and report service levels: response and resolution times, SLAs, and quality scores. Ensure a stellar employee experience in every interaction, timely, accurate, empathetic, and easy. Continuously assess workflows to identify, prioritize, and scope the ones that should be automated, partnering with the People Product Manager to design and deploy those automations and agents. Manage case handling and routing within the tiered service model, resolving at the People Services tier where possible, escalating complex cases to experts, and driving deflection to self-service. Build and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and quality controls so execution is consistent, compliant, and repeatable across regions. Monitor volume trends and root causes, reducing recurring tickets through process fixes, better documentation, and automation. Ensure data accuracy and integrity in our People systems for every transaction the team handles. Handle escalations and sensitive cases with discretion and sound judgment. Partner with HR Technology, People Partners, and centers of excellence to align on process, systems, and clean handoffs. Support compliance and data governance across the markets the team serves. Qualifications and Skills: 5+ years in People/HR Operations, shared services, or service delivery, including direct team leadership or people management. Proven track record running high-volume transactional work to a high quality and accuracy standard. Experience defining and managing SLAs, quality metrics, and day-to-day service delivery. Strong process-improvement instinct: able to spot and prioritize what to automate and partner effectively on building it. Employee-experience mindset, with a bias for making interactions easy and getting the details right. Comfort leveraging People systems and workflow or case-management tools, and partnering with HR Technology rather than administering systems directly. Familiarity with AI or automation in an operations context is a plus. Excellent communication and people-leadership skills. Ability to handle sensitive situations and maintain strict confidentiality. title: Marcom Manager
description:
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers. Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel. Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience Required: - 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred OR - 4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Hotel Marketing and Advertising - Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams. - Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel. - Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions. - Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts. - Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups - Executes email marketing, and display advertising. - Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives. - Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice. Social Media Content Management - Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites). - Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels. - Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly. Public Relations and Visual Asset Management - Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM. - Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers. - Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system. - Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets. - Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities. - Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives. - Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution. - Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s). - Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel. - Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams. - Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team. - Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice. Direct Marketing and Collateral Development - Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials. - Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner. - Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas. - Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis. - Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities. - Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA). General - Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns. - Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s). - Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary. - Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions. - Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis. - Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy. - Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders. - Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance. - Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends. title: Senior Staff Engineer, Layout Design
description:
We are seeking a Senior Staff Layout Design Engineer with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal layout for power and analog IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgment, and the ability to lead layout execution for complex blocks and full-chip designs. The successful candidate will translate circuit requirements into robust, manufacturable layouts for products such as PMICs, linear and switching regulators, gate drivers, battery-management ICs, and other power and analog devices. The role requires close collaboration with analog designers, CAD, process, package, reliability, and verification teams. You will be expected to own challenging layout problems, establish best practices, improve methodology and automation, mentor engineers, and drive projects from floor planning through physical verification and tape-out readiness. Responsibilities Layout Architecture & Execution Own floor planning and physical implementation for complex analog, power, and mixed-signal blocks, and contribute to full-chip layout planning. Collaborate with circuit designers to capture electrical, matching, isolation, current-density, thermal, reliability, and area requirements. Apply advanced layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, noise isolation, high-current routing, electromigration robustness, thermal behavior, and yield optimization. Drive routing, integration, and sign-off readiness for block-level and chip-level layouts. Physical Verification & Sign-off Own and review DRC, LVS, ERC, PEX, antenna, density, latch-up, and reliability verification as required by the process and product. Analyse extracted parasitics with designers and support post-layout simulation closure. Identify physical-design risks early and drive corrective actions with design, CAD, PDK, process, and package teams. Ensure layout databases, review records, and release documentation meet tape-out quality standards. Methodology, Automation & IP Reuse Develop and deploy automation using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar languages to improve quality and turnaround time. Drive layout methodology improvements, reusable templates, checklists, and portability of IP across products and process technologies. Work with corporate engineering and CAD teams to resolve tool, PDK, extraction, and process-flow issues. Evaluate new layout tools and techniques and lead practical adoption within the team. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Lead layout reviews and provide clear estimates, progress updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans. Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers and raise the technical standard of the broader team. Influence project planning, task allocation, technical decisions, and hiring through demonstrated technical depth. Operate independently on ambiguous and complex assignments, escalating issues with clear options and recommendations. Qualifications Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in analog, power, or mixed-signal IC layout and associated development flows. Demonstrated ownership of complex block-level layout and meaningful contribution to full-chip integration and tape-out. Deep understanding of matching, parasitic control, noise isolation, guard rings, latch-up prevention, high-current routing, electromigration, IR drop, thermal effects, and reliability-aware layout. Hands-on expertise with Cadence Virtuoso and physical verification tools such as Calibre, PVS, or equivalent. Experience with extraction and reliability tools is expected. Experience working with deep-submicron CMOS and preferably BCD or high-voltage process technologies. Ability to automate layout or verification tasks using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages. Proven ability to lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and drive layout methodology improvements. Strong cross-functional communication skills in a multisite and multicultural environment. Results-oriented, self-driven, and able to deliver high-quality work under tight schedules with limited supervision.

You will turn advanced GPU, Kubernetes, AI runtime, and agent execution technologies into standardized enterprise services that help teams move AI workloads and agents into production faster, while integrating with enterprise-approved model access, security, and governance services.
