description:
Job Description : Sales & Marketing Enterprise Business Automation Solutions 
 Role Overview 
 Company: Vorizo Infotech India Pvt. Ltd. Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time Experience: Freshers to Experienced Professionals Work Modes: On-Field Sales and Inside Sales Compensation: As per industry standards plus attractive performance incentives 
 Vorizo Infotech India Pvt. Ltd. is building a one-stop enterprise IT solutions business that helps organizations automate, integrate and digitally transform their operations. 
 We provide software products, implementation services, customised solutions, system integration, support and business process automation across Finance, Accounting, Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Management, CRM, HR, Payroll, Taxation, Fixed Assets and Business Intelligence. 
 We are seeking ambitious and customer-focused Sales & Marketing Executives and Managers to help businesses identify the right technology solutions for their needs. This role involves engaging with business leaders, understanding operational challenges and recommending solutions that improve productivity, control costs, strengthen decision-making and support growth. 
 Solution Portfolio 
 Our enterprise technology portfolio includes: 
 - Tally / TallyPrime - SAP Business One - Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central - Oracle NetSuite - SAP ERP / Enterprise Solutions - Oracle Solutions - CRM Solutions - HR & Payroll Solutions - Direct & Indirect Tax Solutions - Fixed Asset Management Solutions - Business Intelligence and MIS Reporting - Customised Software Solutions - System Integration and Automation Solutions 
 Our solutions support the complete business lifecycle: 
 Finance & Accounting Inventory Sales Purchase Order Management CRM HR Payroll Taxation Fixed Assets MIS & BI Reporting 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead Generation and Business Development 
 - Identify, research and develop new business opportunities. - Generate leads through field visits, telephone, email, LinkedIn, networking and other channels. - Build relationships with business owners, CFOs, Finance Heads, HR Heads, IT Heads and senior management. - Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline. - Conduct structured follow-ups and convert qualified prospects into customers. - Build a consultative and value-focused sales approach. 
 Requirement Understanding 
 - Understand customer processes, challenges, priorities and growth plans. - Identify requirements across Finance, Accounting, Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Management, CRM, HR, Payroll, Taxation, Fixed Assets and Business Intelligence. - Translate business challenges into clear solution opportunities. - Coordinate with technical and functional teams for detailed requirement analysis. 
 Solution Selling 
 - Recommend suitable software and technology solutions based on customer requirements. - Position solutions such as Tally, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Oracle and customised applications. - Explain business benefits, return on investment, automation capabilities, scalability and long-term value. - Conduct or coordinate product demonstrations. - Prepare proposals and support commercial discussions with management. - Sell business outcomes and transformation rather than features alone. 
 End-to-End Sales Management 
 Manage and support the complete sales cycle: 
 Lead Generation Qualification Requirement Analysis Product Presentation Demo Proposal Negotiation Closure Implementation Handover Customer Relationship 
 Customer Relationship Management 
 - Build trusted, long-term customer relationships. - Identify opportunities for upgrades, additional modules, integrations and customised solutions. - Coordinate with implementation and support teams to ensure a smooth customer experience. - Contribute to customer retention, satisfaction and account growth. 
 Channel and Referral Development 
 - Build relationships with CAs, CFOs, consultants, IT consultants, business networks and referral partners. - Develop strategic alliances that generate enterprise software opportunities. - Participate in exhibitions, seminars, networking events and business meetings. 
 Work Modes 
 On-Field Sales 
 Responsibilities include: 
 - Meeting customers and prospects. - Developing new business opportunities. - Conducting enterprise meetings. - Generating and qualifying leads. - Coordinating product presentations. - Building customer relationships. - Following up on proposals and commercial discussions. - Driving opportunities toward closure. 
 This mode is ideal for professionals who enjoy meeting people, understanding businesses, building networks and creating opportunities through direct engagement. 
 Inside Sales 
 Responsibilities include: 
 - Calling and qualifying leads. - Generating new business opportunities. - Conducting online product presentations. - Managing structured follow-ups. - Maintaining accurate CRM records. - Generating appointments for sales meetings. - Coordinating proposals and demonstrations. - Supporting field sales activities. - Managing customer communication and relationship development. 
 This mode is ideal for confident communicators who are organized, digitally comfortable and motivated by building a strong sales pipeline through remote engagement. 
 Candidate Requirements 
 We are looking for candidates with: 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills. - Confidence in interacting with business owners and senior decision-makers. - Good interpersonal and relationship-building abilities. - Genuine interest in sales, technology and business development. - Curiosity to understand business operations and technology solutions. - Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development. - A target-oriented, disciplined and self-motivated approach. - Ability to understand business requirements and identify relevant solutions. - Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience in any of the following areas will be an advantage: 
 - Tally / TallyPrime - SAP Business One or SAP ERP - Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central - Oracle NetSuite or Oracle ERP - ERP, CRM or HRMS - Payroll or taxation software - Fixed Asset Management - Business Intelligence or MIS - IT services and software sales - B2B or enterprise sales 
 Candidates who have sold ERP, Accounting, CRM, HRMS or other enterprise software solutions will be preferred. 
 Freshers 
 Freshers with strong communication skills, confidence, enthusiasm, learning agility and a genuine interest in technology sales are encouraged to apply. 
 Product and solution orientation will be provided to help candidates understand our offerings, customer needs and consultative sales process. With the right attitude and consistent performance, freshers can progress into sales, account management or business consulting roles. 
 Benefits and Growth Opportunities 
 - Work across multiple enterprise software and IT solutions. - Gain exposure to leading ERP, CRM and business automation platforms. - Learn about Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, CRM, HR, Payroll, Tax, Fixed Assets and Business Intelligence. - Work with SMEs and enterprise customers. - Gain exposure to product sales, implementation, integration and customised solutions. - Learn through customer interactions and collaboration with technical and functional teams. - Earn attractive performance-based incentives. - Receive recognition and growth opportunities for consistent performance. - Progress based on capability, ownership and results. - Build a career in enterprise technology sales and business consulting. - Make a visible impact by helping businesses improve efficiency, control and growth. 
 Why Join Vorizo Infotech? 
 This is not a traditional single-product sales role. You will learn to understand a customer’s complete business requirements and recommend the right technology solution for their specific needs. 
 You will have the opportunity to: 
 - Develop expertise across multiple enterprise technology platforms. - Understand how different business functions operate and connect. - Work directly with business owners and senior decision-makers. - Build consultative selling, negotiation and relationship-management skills. - Contribute to projects that improve organizational efficiency. - Progress from lead generation and sales execution into account management, consulting or leadership roles. - Earn attractive incentives by creating measurable business value. 
 Our approach is: 
 Understand the Business Identify the Problem Recommend the Right Technology Implement Integrate Customise Support Grow with the Customer

title: Experiential Marketing Manager (Retail Activation & Campaigning)
description:
Function: Marketing
 Sub-Function: Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning)
 Designation: Manager / Deputy Manager Marketing
 Joining Location: Mumbai Andheri East
 Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC)
 Regional Responsibility: West Region, with oversight of North Region resources
 Reporting To: Senior Manager Marketing & VM
 Experience: 7+ years, preferably 89 years
 Qualification: Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing Role Overview The Manager / Deputy Manager – Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning) will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing experiential marketing, retail activation, and consumer engagement initiatives across the West region. The role will play a key part in translating brand and marketing strategies into impactful retail campaigns and on-ground consumer experiences that strengthen brand awareness, increase store engagement and support business and sales objectives. In addition to managing marketing activation initiatives for the West region, the role will also be responsible for coordinating with and overseeing the deliverables of marketing resources supporting the North region , providing direction, guidance, and mentorship to ensure consistency in execution, timelines, and brand standards. The incumbent will work closely with the Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Sales, Creative, Digital, and external agency teams to ensure seamless planning and execution of campaigns, events, activations, and other consumer-facing initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1. Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing Strategy Support the development and execution of regional experiential marketing and retail activation strategies aligned with overall brand and business objectives. Translate national marketing campaigns and brand priorities into relevant regional and local market activation plans. Identify opportunities to enhance consumer engagement through innovative retail experiences, events, activations, and localized campaigns. Develop activation concepts that are relevant to the target consumer and aligned with the brand's positioning. Ensure all regional activations maintain consistency with brand guidelines and communication standards. Recommend new and innovative activation formats based on market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity. 2. Campaign Planning & Execution Plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across retail, experiential, events, print, digital and other relevant channels. Own regional campaign calendars and ensure timely execution of planned marketing initiatives. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies/vendors for campaign planning and execution. Prepare detailed campaign briefs, execution plans, timelines, and deliverables. Monitor campaign implementation from conceptualization through execution and closure. Ensure all campaign assets, branding elements and communication materials are delivered within agreed timelines. Conduct post-campaign reviews and identify opportunities for improvement. 3. Retail Store Activation Partner with Retail Operations and Sales teams to identify opportunities for increasing customer footfall, engagement, and conversion through localized activations. Develop and execute store-level promotional activities, consumer engagement programs, and local marketing initiatives. Support new store launches, store anniversaries, key retail moments and other business-critical initiatives. Develop activation plans for high-priority stores, malls, markets, and catchment areas. Ensure activation activities are aligned with store objectives and deliver measurable business impact. Gather feedback from stores and regional teams to continuously improve activation effectiveness. 4. Experiential Events, Partnerships & Sponsorships Plan and execute experiential events, consumer engagement activities, brand experiences, and promotional events. Identify and evaluate opportunities for relevant partnerships, sponsorships, collaborations, and local events. Coordinate with athletes, influencers, event partners, malls, retailers, and other external stakeholders where applicable. Manage event agencies and other external partners to ensure quality and timely execution. Ensure event experiences are consistent with brand identity and provide meaningful consumer engagement. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports with key learnings and recommendations. 5. Market & Consumer Research Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, retail trends, and competitor marketing activities. Conduct market scans to identify relevant opportunities for regional activations. Analyze competitor campaigns, events, promotions, and consumer engagement initiatives. Provide insights to the marketing team on regional consumer preferences and market opportunities. Use market intelligence to recommend localized marketing initiatives and improve campaign effectiveness. 6. Brand Management & Compliance Ensure consistent implementation of brand guidelines across all regional activations and consumer touchpoints. Work closely with creative and VM teams to ensure all campaign communication and physical branding elements meet brand standards. Review marketing collateral, activation concepts, and event branding before execution. Ensure agencies, vendors and other partners understand and adhere to brand requirements. Identify and address any gaps in brand execution across the region. 7. Creative & Content Coordination Work with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop campaign and activation communication. Prepare clear creative briefs covering campaign objectives, target audience, messaging, deliverables, and timelines. Coordinate development of promotional assets, event communication, retail communication, and digital content as required. Review creative outputs and provide relevant feedback to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines. Coordinate with digital and social media teams to amplify relevant retail activation and experiential initiatives. 8. Social Media & Digital Integration Coordinate with digital/social media teams to ensure relevant experiential and retail campaigns receive appropriate digital amplification. Support the development of content around events, activations, launches, and consumer engagement initiatives. Monitor campaign-related digital engagement and consumer response. Identify opportunities to integrate offline retail experiences with digital marketing initiatives. Ensure regional activation content is aligned with the overall digital communication strategy. 9. Collaboration with Sales & Retail Operations Work closely with Sales, Retail Operations and VM teams to understand regional business priorities and translate them into marketing activation plans. Support sales teams with relevant marketing initiatives that contribute to store traffic, consumer engagement, and sales. Participate in regional business reviews and provide marketing recommendations. Ensure marketing initiatives are planned based on store requirements, business priorities, and market potential. Establish strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of campaigns. 10. West Region Ownership Take end-to-end ownership of retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives for the West region. Develop regional activation plans based on business priorities, market potential, and consumer insights. Manage the regional marketing calendar and ensure timely execution. Coordinate with stores, regional business teams, agencies, and vendors. Monitor execution quality and ensure timely resolution of regional activation-related issues. Evaluate the effectiveness of regional initiatives and share actionable insights with the senior marketing team. 11. North Region Resource Oversight & Mentoring Provide functional guidance and mentorship to marketing resources supporting the North region. Review and monitor the North team's marketing activation plans, timelines, and deliverables. Ensure consistency in campaign execution, brand standards and reporting across West and North regions. Support North resources in campaign planning, agency coordination, event execution, and problem-solving. Review key deliverables and provide constructive feedback to improve quality and effectiveness. Act as a point of coordination between North regional resources and the central Marketing & VM team wherever required. Track progress against agreed deliverables and escalate critical gaps or delays to the reporting manager. Build capability within the North resources through regular guidance, knowledge sharing and best-practice sharing. 12. Agency & Vendor Management Identify, coordinate, and manage experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production partners, and other vendors. Brief agencies clearly on campaign objectives, scope, timelines, and expected deliverables. Evaluate agency proposals and execution plans based on quality, relevance, feasibility, and cost. Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and deliverables. Ensure proper documentation and closure of marketing activities with external partners. Build strong agency/vendor relationships while maintaining commercial discipline. 13. Budget Management & Cost Optimization Support planning and management of regional marketing and activation budgets. Track campaign and activation spend against approved budgets. Ensure effective utilization of marketing spends and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Review vendor quotations and proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Maintain appropriate documentation for marketing spends approvals and campaign closures. Ensure activities are executed within approved financial parameters. 14. Campaign Performance & Reporting Establish relevant KPIs for retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives. Track campaign performance, consumer engagement, footfall, participation, and other relevant metrics. Prepare regular reports on campaign progress, spends, execution status and business impact. Conduct post-campaign analysis and identify key learnings. Provide actionable recommendations to improve future campaigns. Maintain a structured repository of campaign plans, reports, photographs, learnings, and performance data. 15. Cross-Functional Coordination Collaborate with Marketing, VM, Retail Operations, Sales, Digital, Creative, Finance and other internal stakeholders. Ensure effective communication of campaign requirements and timelines across functions. Coordinate multiple stakeholders simultaneously to ensure seamless campaign execution. Proactively identify execution challenges and drive timely resolution. Act as a strong bridge between the central marketing team and regional business teams. 
 Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have: 7+ years of relevant experience , preferably 8–9 years, in Marketing, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing, Brand Activation, Events or a related field. Prior experience in retail, consumer-facing, lifestyle, footwear, fashion, FMCG, consumer durables or other retail-oriented industries will be preferred. Strong hands-on experience in experiential marketing, retail activations, events, and campaign execution . Experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong understanding of retail marketing and consumer engagement. Experience working with creative, experiential and event agencies. Ability to independently manage regional marketing initiatives from planning to execution and evaluation. Experience in mentoring or guiding junior/peer resources will be an advantage. Strong commercial understanding and ability to manage marketing budgets effectively. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment. Educational Qualification Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing from a recognized institute. Additional certification in Digital Marketing, Brand Management, Experiential Marketing or Event Management would be an advantage. Technical & Functional Skills Strong knowledge of Experiential Marketing and Retail Activation . Campaign planning and execution. Event management and consumer engagement. Agency and vendor management. Market and competitor analysis. Budget tracking and cost management. Campaign performance measurement and reporting. Strong understanding of retail marketing dynamics. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word . Strong presentation and report-making skills. Familiarity with digital marketing and social media platforms. Ability to interpret campaign data and derive actionable insights.

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing & SEO Executive who can take ownership of Worktable's complete online presence, generate quality leads and continuously improve our digital visibility and website conversions. This is an execution-focused role. The person should be able to plan, execute, monitor and improve digital marketing activities independently. Key Responsibilities 1. Social Media Management Manage Worktable's LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook pages. Create and maintain a monthly social media content calendar. Plan and publish posts, reels, carousels, stories and other relevant content. Improve followers, reach, engagement and overall brand visibility. Research trending topics and relevant coworking/office-space content. Coordinate with designers/content creators wherever required. Maintain consistent branding across all social platforms. Track social media performance and suggest improvements. 2. Google Business Profile (GMB) Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for Worktable locations. Ensure correct business name, address, phone number, website, categories and business information. Add/update photos, services, descriptions and other relevant information. Regularly publish Google Business Profile posts. Improve local SEO and Google Maps visibility . Monitor customer reviews and coordinate responses. Identify opportunities to increase calls, website visits and direction requests. Track GMB performance and generate reports. Work on local keywords for coworking, managed office, private office, meeting rooms, etc. 3. SEO & Keyword Management Conduct keyword research for coworking, managed offices, private offices, meeting rooms and related services. Identify high-intent and location-based keywords. Conduct competitor SEO research. Implement on-page SEO. Manage Meta Titles, Meta Descriptions and relevant Meta Tags . Optimize H1, H2 and other heading structures. Optimize URLs, internal linking and anchor text. Optimize image ALT tags and file names. Identify keyword gaps and ranking opportunities. Plan and optimize website content around relevant keywords. Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic. 4. Website SEO & Optimization Manage basic SEO activities directly on the Worktable website. Update page titles, descriptions, headings, keywords and content. Optimize landing pages for search engines and lead generation. Identify broken links, indexing issues, duplicate content and other basic SEO issues. Coordinate with the website developer for technical SEO changes. Ensure new website pages are properly optimized before publishing. Suggest new landing pages based on search demand. Improve website structure, navigation and internal linking. Ensure important pages are properly indexed by Google. Basic knowledge of WordPress/CMS will be preferred. 5. Lead Generation The candidate will be responsible for generating qualified business leads , not just website traffic. Plan and execute lead-generation campaigns. Generate leads through Google, Meta, LinkedIn, GMB, SEO and other relevant channels . Understand the difference between traffic, enquiries and qualified leads. Create and optimize lead-generation landing pages. Set up and optimize lead forms. Track lead source and campaign performance. Monitor CPL (Cost Per Lead), number of leads and lead quality . Work with the sales team to understand lead quality and improve campaigns accordingly. Maintain proper lead tracking and reporting. Identify new digital channels and opportunities for lead generation. 6. Website Forms & Lead Capture The candidate should understand how website enquiries are captured and routed. Create/maintain enquiry forms on the website. Forms may include: Name Mobile Number Email Requirement – Coworking / Managed Office Number of Seats Preferred Location Move-in Requirement / Timeline Any other relevant requirement Ensure form submissions are successfully received by the relevant team. Test forms regularly to ensure there are no missed enquiries. Set up proper thank-you/confirmation messages where required. Track form submissions and conversion rates. Coordinate with the developer for form, API, tracking or technical requirements. 7. Website Conversion & CRO The candidate should also understand how to convert website visitors into enquiries . Add/optimize WhatsApp, Call and Email CTA buttons . Suggest suitable enquiry buttons at relevant places on the website. Create/optimize enquiry pop-ups. Suggest lead-capture forms based on visitor intent. Improve landing-page conversion. Test different CTA text, forms and placement. Track website enquiries and conversion rates. Identify pages receiving traffic but generating fewer leads and recommend improvements. 8. Meta Marketing & Advertising Manage Meta Business Suite . Plan and publish content on Facebook and Instagram. Create and monitor Meta Ads campaigns. Run lead-generation campaigns where required. Set up audiences and basic retargeting campaigns. Monitor budget, CPL, leads and campaign performance. Optimize campaigns based on results. Coordinate creatives and ad copies with the team. 9. Google Ads Basic hands-on knowledge of Google Ads will be preferred. Search campaign setup and management. Keyword research. Negative keyword management. Ad copy optimization. Location and audience targeting. Lead conversion tracking. Monitoring CPC, CPL and conversion rate. Basic campaign optimization. 10. Google Search Console & Analytics Manage Google Search Console. Monitor indexing and search performance. Track clicks, impressions, CTR and average position. Identify search queries and ranking opportunities. Monitor website traffic through Google Analytics. Track important website conversions and enquiry sources. Prepare regular performance reports. 11. Content & Local SEO Identify topics based on customer search behaviour. Create content briefs for blogs and landing pages. Optimize existing website content. Work on location-based pages for different Worktable centres/markets. Build local SEO visibility. Suggest content that can generate organic enquiries. 12. Tracking & Analytics Candidate should understand basic digital marketing tracking, including: Google Analytics Google Search Console Meta Pixel Conversion tracking UTM parameters Lead-source tracking Website form tracking Call/WhatsApp enquiry tracking Campaign performance tracking 13. Reporting & MIS Prepare weekly/monthly reports covering: Website traffic Organic traffic Keyword rankings GMB performance Social media growth Social media engagement Leads generated Qualified leads Cost per lead Meta Ads performance Google Ads performance Website enquiries Conversion rate The person should not only provide numbers but also highlight what is working, what is not working and what should be done next. title: Digital Marketing Specialist at Highadvocacy
description:
HighAdvocacy is hiring its first marketing person. Your job is to take our website from where it is today to 10,000+ qualified monthly visitors in the next six months. Youll get there through earned channels: blog posts that rank on Google, a real LinkedIn cadence on the company page and on the founders personal one, Reddit and X threads where our buyers hang out, and one or two channels youll find by testing a handful. For the first 60 days, Piyush (our co-founder) works alongside you. Hell review drafts, help you build a point of view, and give real feedback. After that, you start making the channel calls. By month six, youre the marketing brain of the company and Piyush is reviewing your decisions, not making them. This is a full-time, in-office role in Ahmedabad. You report directly to Piyush. Theres no agency next to you, no senior marketer above you, and no playbook on a shared drive. The brand voice on the internet six months from now will largely be the one you ship. What youll actually be doing Write 2-4 blog posts a week. Useful enough to rank on Google, honest enough to share. Run a 5x/week LinkedIn cadence on the company page. Collaborate with Piyush on posts from his personal profile. Find 15-20 conversations a week on Reddit, X, and LinkedIn where our ICP is asking real questions. Reply like a human, not a brand account. Live inside Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Plausible. Use them to debug whats working, not to confirm what you already believe. Test one new channel every month: a newsletter swap, a podcast appearance, a community partnership. Be honest about whether its worth continuing. Ship a short dashboard every Friday. What went out, what moved, what youre trying next. Build a small library of templates, post formats, and frameworks the next hire can pick up. What success looks like Well measure progress against these checkpoints together: 4 blog posts shipped; a LinkedIn cadence running 5x/week; 15+ thoughtful Reddit or X comments out in the wild. You've tested SEO, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, and one community channel. You bring a written recommendation on which 1-2 channels deserve 70% of your time, defended in a Friday review. 5,000 qualified monthly visitors; at least one channel running on autopilot, without Piyush reviewing every piece of output. 10,000 qualified monthly visitors. Compounding output across two channels. Youre making channel-level decisions with light founder review. How we think about AI in this role We expect you to use AI every day. The difference we care about is using it as leverage versus using it as a crutch. Heres how we actually use these tools: Claude or ChatGPT - Drafting blog outlines, ideating angles, rewriting weak sections, testing your thinking, summarizing competitor content. Perplexity - Fast research, finding sources and statistics, sanity-checking claims before publishing. Ahrefs AI features - Keyword clustering, content gap analysis, surfacing backlink prospects. AI for repurposing - Turning one blog into a LinkedIn post, an X thread, and a Reddit reply, without making them sound like the same recycled paragraph. Pattern analysis - Pulling apart top-performing posts in our space and figuring out what's actually working. Cursor or v0 (bonus) - Spinning up small landing page experiments without waiting on a designer. What we dont want: AI-generated final copy anyone can spot in three seconds. Your taste and voice ship the final draft. AI gets you to about 60% of the work, faster. The last 40%, the part that makes it sound human, is on you. Who we're hoping applies The best signal for this role isn't years of experience or a degree. It's whether you live on the internet and pay attention to how things land. This role is probably right for you if a few of these are true: Youve drafted a LinkedIn post or a tweet in your head while showering. You can name 5 people you follow on X and explain why for each. You read the comments under good LinkedIn posts to figure out why they worked. Youd rather ship 50 honest LinkedIn posts than 1 polished case study that took a month to approve. You think most B2B SaaS marketing reads like the same paragraph copy-pasted across the internet, and you can point at examples. Youve shipped something publicly on your own time: a blog, an X account, a side project, a newsletter. Audience size doesnt matter. The shipping does. You use AI to move faster through the boring parts, not to think for you. Who probably shouldnt apply Skip this role if any of these feel true: You need a playbook handed to you before you can start. The first thing on your resume is HubSpot Certified or a marketing degree. You havent shipped anything publicly outside a job you were paid for. You find Ahrefs intimidating and dont want to learn it. You're hoping someone else (an agency, a senior, the founder) does the work and you review it. What we're not asking for None of these are required. Don't filter yourself out if you don't have them: Prior B2B SaaS experience. You'll pick up the context in two weeks. SEO certifications. Ahrefs and a few good blogs will teach you more in a month. Paid ads experience. Out of scope for this role. Video or design skills. Not what we need here. HubSpot, Marketo, or any specific automation tool. We dont use them.

 Please find below Job Description for your reference: Job Location: Bengaluru Total Experience: 1- 4 Years Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 15 days Shifts: Flexible to work for any shift (Including Night Shifts) Work From Office is mandatory Job Level: 2A/ 3A Designation: Senior Process Executive / Process Specialist Qualification: Any Graduate (Full-Time) 
 Note: Candidates must have mandatory experience in international processes. 
 Job Summary: We are seeking detail-oriented and customer-focused Utility Billing Operations Associates to support utility billing and resident billing operations for multifamily and student housing clients. This is a semi-voice role involving a combination of data processing, billing validation, email communication, and outbound/inbound interactions with utility providers, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely resident billing. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Utility Bill Processing & Data Management: Retrieve utility bills from provider websites, portals, and client submissions. Download, validate, upload, and archive utility bills following established procedures. Verify account information, service periods, billing amounts, and resident data. Maintain audit-ready documentation and billing records. Perform resident data validation including move-ins, move-outs, transfers, and account updates. 
 B. Client & Provider Communication (Semi-Voice) Contact utility providers, property management teams, and clients via phone and email to obtain required billing information. Follow up on pending utility bills, account information, and billing discrepancies. Communicate billing status updates, missing documentation, and issue resolutions professionally. Handle inbound and outbound calls related to billing inquiries and operational support. Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate teams for resolution. 
 C. Billing Validation & Reconciliation: Review pre-bills, utility charges, statement data, and occupancy records for accuracy. Investigate billing discrepancies, charge variances, and exception reports. Perform data comparisons and reconciliations using Excel and operational systems. Ensure all billing exceptions are resolved before final approval. 
 D. Exception Management: Identify and investigate issues related to: Missing utility bills, Duplicate charges, Data import failures, New utility accounts, Incorrect billing information, System or access-related issues etc Coordinate with internal support teams and clients to resolve exceptions. Process Tracking & Documentation Adhere to quality, compliance, and audit requirements. 
 Required Skills: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Comfortable handling outbound and inbound calls. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic formulas). Ability to analyze and validate data accurately. Experience handling large volumes of operational data. Basic understanding of billing, finance, or data processing operations. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile: Strong communication skills with the ability to confidently engage with clients and service providers. Detail-oriented with excellent data validation and reconciliation skills. Comfortably balancing operational tasks with customer interactions. Proactive in identifying issues and driving resolutions. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 
 Documents to Carry: Carry a printout your updated resume. Carry any 2 photo Identity proof (PAN Card/Driving License/Voters ID card/Passport). All original education documents needs to be available for verification. (10th, 12th, Graduation (Sem Wise Marksheet, CMM. Provisional and Original Degree) 
 Mandatory to carry: Smartphone with good front camera, charger and Headset for Assessment, Government ID proof Hardcopy. 
 Pointers to note: Please do not carry laptops/cameras to the venue as these will not be allowed due to security restrictions. Original Government ID card is must for Security Clearance

title: Staff Platform Operations Engineer(Snowflake)
description:
Role Overview 
 The Senior Staff Platform Operations Engineer is responsible for owning the day-to-day operational health, reliability, and continuous improvement of Danaher's Enterprise Data Platform - including Snowflake, Azure, Matillion, dbt, and Airflow - ensuring data pipelines, warehouses, and downstream consumers (analytics, AI, and reporting) run securely, predictably, and at enterprise scale. This role drives incident response, automation, cost and performance optimization, and operational governance across the L1/L2 support model, directly enabling Danaher's OpCos and enterprise functions to make data-driven decisions. Location: Bangalore. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Own end-to-end operations and support of the Enterprise Data Platform (Snowflake, Azure, AWS, Matillion, dbt, and Airflow), including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SLA management, L1/L2 support execution, runbook management, task/pipeline triage, MTTR reduction, and escalation to L3 Solutions as required. Drive operational excellence through automation, observability, and self-healing capabilities, including runbooks-as-code, automated remediation, observability dashboards, GenAI-assisted triage, and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve platform reliability. Manage platform governance, security, performance, and economics, including access management, provisioning, compliance controls, cost optimization, capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational governance across the data platform ecosystem. Partner with Data Engineering, AI Solutions, Architecture, and Security teams to translate operational insights into platform enhancements, scalability plans, risk mitigation strategies, and audit-ready evidence supporting SOX, SOC, and internal audit requirements. Lead and develop a team of Data Operations Engineers and vendor partners, establishing standardized operating procedures, runbooks, on-call rotations, incident management practices, post-incident reviews, and a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence. 
 
 Essential Requirements 
 8+ years of progressive experience in data platform operations, data engineering, or DevOps/SRE roles, with at least 3 years operating a cloud-native enterprise data platform (Snowflake or equivalent) in a regulated environment. Hands-on expertise across the modern data cloud stack - Snowflake, Fabric, Databricks Demonstrated experience leading L1/L2 platform operations , including incident management (ServiceNow or equivalent), on-call ownership, SLA reporting, runbook authorship, and automation of operational tasks (Python/SQL/Terraform/Pulumi). Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent professional experience). 
 
 Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements 
 Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and occasionally internationally for team meetings, vendor reviews, and OpCo engagements.

description:

Job Description: 
 Primary (70%): Web scraping architecture anti-bot, distributed crawling, proxy/CAPTCHA 
 strategy, compliance 
 •
 •
 Secondary (30%): Data engineering pipelines, lakehouse, orchestration, dbt 
 Mandatory ownership of the technical solution and effort estimation for every new 
 scraping proposal/RFP 
 •
 •
 Senior profile: 9+ years overall, 5+ years in scraping, 4+ years in data engineering 
 Technical Lead / Architect Web Scraping & Data Engineering 
 Role Title Solution Architect Web Scraping (Primary) & Data Engineering (Secondary) 
 Location: Remote 
 Primary Focus Web Scraping & Data Extraction Architecture (~70%) 
 Secondary Focus Data Engineering & Pipeline Architecture (~30%) 
 1. Role Summary: 
 We are seeking a Technical lead the design and delivery of large-scale web scraping and 
 data extraction solutions, with strong supporting expertise in data engineering, the 
 technical authority on all scraping initiatives from pre-sales solutioning and effort 
 estimation through to architecture, build, and stabilization. 
 The primary mandate is web scraping: designing resilient crawlers, anti-bot strategies, 
 distributed extraction systems, and compliance frameworks. The secondary mandate is 
 data engineering: ensuring extracted data flows reliably into well-modelled, query-ready 
 storage layers and downstream analytical or operational systems. 
 Mandatory Involvement Areas: 
 •
 •
 •
 Author or co-author the technical solution section of every new RFP / RFI / proposal 
 document for scraping projects. 
 Lead technical discovery calls with prospective clients to understand target sources, data 
 SLAs, volume, and compliance constraints. 
 Conduct target-site feasibility assessments anti-bot complexity, dynamic content, 
 login walls, geo-restrictions, rate limits and document findings before commercials 
 are committed. 
 •
 •
 Own end-to-end effort estimation for scraping engagements: crawler build effort, 
 infrastructure sizing, proxy and CAPTCHA cost projections, maintenance overhead, and 
 contingency. 
 Produce solution architecture diagrams, tech stack recommendations, and assumption 
 logs as part of every proposal. 
 •
 •
 Define and document SLAs, KPIs, and acceptance criteria proposed to the client. 
 Participate in client orals, technical defence sessions, and commercial negotiations as 
 the technical SPOC. 
 •
 Maintain an internal estimation knowledge base reusable estimation templates, 
 complexity matrices, target-site classification, and historical actuals and continuously 
 refine it after every project closure. 
 
 
 
 •
 Sign off on the technical feasibility and risk profile of every proposal before submission. 
 No scraping proposal goes out without architect approval. 
 3. Core Responsibilities 
 3.1 Scraping Architecture & Design (Primary) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Design end-to-end scraping solutions covering crawl orchestration, extraction, parsing, 
 storage, and downstream data consumption. 
 Define reference architectures for high-volume, high-velocity, and high-variety scraping 
 use cases. 
 Architect resilient systems handling JavaScript-heavy sites, CAPTCHAs, rate limiting, IP 
 blocking, and frequent DOM changes. 
 Evaluate and select frameworks, proxy networks, and anti-bot bypass strategies aligned 
 with cost, performance, and compliance. 
 Design data quality, deduplication, validation, and schema-evolution strategies for 
 scraped data. 
 3.2 Data Engineering Architecture (Secondary) 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Design downstream data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve scraped data to 
 analytics, ML, or operational consumers. 
 Architect lakehouse / warehouse layers, define data modelling standards (dimensional, 
 Data Vault, or hybrid), and govern schema evolution. 
 Define ELT/ETL patterns, orchestration strategy, and SLA-backed data freshness 
 commitments. 
 Establish data quality, observability, lineage, and cataloguing practices across the 
 platform. 
 Recommend storage formats, partitioning, and indexing strategies for cost and query 
 performance. 
 3.3 Delivery Leadership 
 •
 Translate business requirements into technical specifications, sprint plans, and 
 implementation roadmaps. 
 •
 •
 Produce HLD, LLD, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for each engagement. 
 Provide hands-on guidance, perform code reviews, and mentor scraping and data 
 engineers. 
 •
 Drive proof-of-concept (PoC) builds for complex or high-risk targets before full-scale 
 rollout. 
 3.4 Compliance, Risk & Governance 
 •
 •
 •
 Ensure all scraping work adheres to applicable laws and platform terms (GDPR, CCPA, 
 DPDP, robots.txt, copyright). 
 Define and enforce ethical scraping practices, request throttling, and PII handling 
 guidelines. 
 Conduct risk assessments for each target source and recommend mitigations. 
 
 
 
 3.5 Performance, Cost & Operations 
 •
 •
 •
 Establish SLAs for crawl freshness, completeness, and accuracy. 
 Design monitoring, alerting, and self-healing mechanisms for scraping pipelines. 
 Optimise infrastructure cost (compute, proxies, storage) without compromising delivery 
 KPIs. 
 4. Required Technical Skills Primary (Web Scraping) 
 These are non-negotiable. The candidate must demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise in 
 each of the following: 
 4.1 Scraping Frameworks & Tooling 
 •
 •
 •
 Expert-level Python: Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, lxml, Requests, httpx, parsel. 
 Headless browser automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Pyppeteer. 
 Node.js scraping stack (where applicable): Puppeteer, Cheerio, Crawlee. 
 4.2 Anti-Bot & Evasion Strategy 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Proven experience bypassing Cloudflare, Akamai Bot Manager, DataDome, PerimeterX, 
 Imperva, Kasada. 
 CAPTCHA handling: reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, image / audio solvers; 
 integration with 2Captcha, Anti-Captcha, CapSolver. 
 TLS / JA3 / JA4 fingerprinting awareness; HTTP/2 fingerprint evasion; browser fingerprint 
 spoofing. 
 Stealth plugins, user-agent rotation, header normalisation, cookie / session 
 management at scale. 
 4.3 Proxy & Network Infrastructure 
 •
 •
 •
 Hands-on experience with rotating, residential, mobile, ISP, and datacenter proxies. 
 Integration with providers: Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, NetNut, IPRoyal, SOAX. 
 Proxy pool design, health-checking, geo-targeting, sticky sessions, and cost optimisation. 
 4.4 Parsing & Extraction 
 •
 •
 •
 XPath, CSS selectors, regex, JSON-LD, microdata, RDFa. 
 Reverse-engineering of internal / mobile APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and XHR traffic. 
 ML/LLM-assisted extraction for unstructured layouts (nice-to-have, increasingly 
 expected). 
 4.5 Distributed Crawling & Orchestration 
 •
 Scrapy-Redis, Scrapy Cluster, Frontera, Crawlee, or equivalent distributed crawling 
 frameworks. 
 •
 •
 Job scheduling and orchestration with Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or Celery. 
 Queue-based architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, GCP Pub/Sub. 
 5. Required Technical Skills Secondary (Data Engineering) 
 
 
 
 Working-to-strong proficiency expected. The architect must be able to design, review, and 
 guide data engineering work without depending on a separate data architect. 
 5.1 Data Pipelines & Orchestration 
 •
 ETL / ELT design patterns, idempotent pipelines, CDC (Change Data Capture), 
 incremental loads. 
 •
 •
 •
 Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, GCP Dataflow. 
 Stream processing: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming. 
 Batch processing: Apache Spark (PySpark), Databricks, EMR, Dataproc. 
 5.2 Data Modelling & Storage 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Dimensional modelling (Kimball), Data Vault 2.0, normalised vs. denormalised trade-offs. 
 Data warehouses: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, Databricks SQL Warehouse. 
 Data lakes / lakehouses: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi on S3 / GCS / ADLS. 
 OLTP databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL; NoSQL: MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, 
 Elasticsearch, Redis. 
 •
 File formats: Parquet, Avro, ORC, JSON, CSV; partitioning, bucketing, compaction 
 strategies. 
 5.3 Transformation & Quality 
 •
 •
 •
 dbt (data build tool) for transformation, testing, and documentation. 
 Data quality frameworks: Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ, custom validators. 
 Data lineage and cataloguing: DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen, Atlan, Collibra. 
 5.4 Cloud, DevOps & Observability 
 •
 Strong on at least one of AWS, GCP, Azure (compute, storage, IAM, networking, 
 serverless). 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Containerisation and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS / GKE / AKS), ECS. 
 Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation. 
 CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD. 
 Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / OpenSearch, Datadog, Sentry, 
 OpenTelemetry. 
 6. Experience & Qualifications 
 •
 •
 •
 •
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 10+ years of overall software engineering experience. 
 5+ years dedicated to large-scale web scraping / data extraction (primary). 
 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience covering pipelines, warehouses / 
 lakehouses, and orchestration (secondary). 
 •
 •
 Proven track record of architecting scraping platforms processing millions of pages per 
 day across diverse target sites. 
 Prior experience as Solution Architect, Tech Lead, or Principal Engineer leading teams of 
 5+ engineers. 
 
 
 
 •
 •
 Demonstrated experience in pre-sales / proposal authoring / RFP responses for scraping 
 or data engineering engagements. 
 Client-facing consulting experience strongly preferred. 
 7. Soft Skills 
 •
 •
 Excellent written and verbal communication; able to defend technical proposals to CXO- 
 level audiences. 
 Strong commercial acumen understands the cost / risk / quality trade-offs in 
 estimation. 
 •
 •
 •
 Analytical, structured problem-solving mindset. 
 Ownership-driven, comfortable being the single point of technical accountability. 
 High standards for documentation, knowledge transfer, and reusability. 
 8. Expected Deliverables (RFP Scope)

 •
 •

 Technical solution sections of all proposal documents.

 Solution architecture diagrams and tech stack recommendations for proposals. 
 Delivery Phase

 •
 •
 •
 •

 High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents per initiative. 
 Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). 
 Reference implementations / PoCs for complex extraction scenarios. 
 Code review records and engineering standards documentation. 
 Operational runbooks, monitoring playbooks, and incident response procedures. 
 Compliance and data governance documentation. 
 Knowledge transfer sessions and final handover documentation. 
 9. Nice-to-Have 
 •
 •
 ML / NLP-based extraction, entity resolution, or LLM-assisted parsing experience. 
 Exposure to GraphQL, gRPC, mobile API reverse-engineering, mitmproxy / Charles 
 workflows. 
 •
 Domain experience: e-commerce price intelligence, market research, financial data, real

 •
 •
 Open-source contributions to scraping or data engineering ecosystems.

Job Summary The Body Construction Engineering Manager Process Simulation Virtual Commissioning is responsible for leading and developing a high-performing engineering team supporting Body-in-White (BIW) manufacturing operations through advanced digital manufacturing technologies. This role provides both technical and people leadership across process simulation, robotics validation, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. The position works closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Controls Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing IT, suppliers, and plant operations teams to identify manufacturing risks early, optimize manufacturing processes, and improve production readiness prior to equipment installation and production launch. The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing digital manufacturing capabilities, improving engineering efficiency, and establishing simulation and virtual commissioning standards across multiple automotive manufacturing programs and facilities. Team Leadership Capability Development Build, lead, and develop a Body Process Simulation team supporting BIW manufacturing engineering activities. Define team structure, technical responsibilities, engineering standards, work processes, deliverables, and performance expectations. Lead, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of engineers, simulation specialists, controls engineers, contractors, and supplier resources. Recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in process simulation, robotics, offline programming, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies. Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs, training plans, and career development pathways. Manage resource planning, project workloads, budgets, supplier support, and delivery performance across multiple manufacturing programs and locations. Foster a culture focused on safety, collaboration, innovation, quality, continuous improvement, and standardization. Establish standard methodologies for: Robot reach and accessibility studies Collision detection and avoidance Cycle time validation Tooling and weld gun accessibility validation Ergonomic assessments Robot path optimization Station layout verification Ensure simulation activities support manufacturing feasibility reviews, equipment design validation, tooling development, and process planning. Develop and maintain simulation models, robot libraries, tooling standards, process libraries, work instructions, and best practices. Improve simulation quality, model accuracy, data management practices, and process validation efficiency. Identify and communicate manufacturing risks, design concerns, capacity constraints, automation challenges, and process issues early during program development. Virtual Commissioning Develop organizational capability in virtual commissioning technologies and methodologies. Lead validation of robot sequences, programmable logic controller (PLC) logic, safety interlocks, equipment interfaces, and automated manufacturing processes in a virtual environment. Define virtual commissioning standards, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and deployment methodologies. Collaborate with Controls Engineering, equipment suppliers, and plant teams to ensure an effective transition from virtual to physical commissioning. Support issue resolution related to robotics, controls, automation systems, simulation models, commissioning activities, and production support. Support the adoption of advanced digital tools, data analytics, digital twins, and AI-enabled engineering solutions to improve engineering productivity, manufacturing risk identification, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, and decision support. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About Metayb Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital-first era. We have grown into a close-knit family of 500+ employees , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital-first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise lie in Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services . We strongly aspire to venture into IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality . Metayb endeavours to be best-in-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager to manage and coordinate end-to-end logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on Saudi Arabia and Egypt . The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the Head of Logistics to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets. This role is based in Chennai and operates on a 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift. The working week is Saturday to Thursday , with Friday as the weekly off . Key Responsibilities Shipment Planning & Coordination Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules. Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets . Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day-to-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision-making. Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics , maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information. Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution. Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders . Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks . Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness . Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations. Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end-to-end supply chain and logistics process . Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments. Transportation & Logistics Management Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets . Liaise with transport vendors, third-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution. Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance. Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions. Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams . Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance . Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues. Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance . Supply Chain Operations & SAP Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day-to-day supply chain operations. Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems. Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle . Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks . Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain. Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance . Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations. Stakeholder & Vendor Management Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders . Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones. Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders . Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations. Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions. Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations. Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery. Qualifications Bachelors Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline . 15-20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations. Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments . Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management . Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred. Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred. Arabic-speaking candidates will be given priority. Required Skills Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end-to-end supply chain processes . Strong hands-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel . Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination . Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations . Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills. Strong customer-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities . High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility . Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast-paced, international environment . Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance . Ability to work effectively with multi-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones . Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems . Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage. Preferred Experience Experience in the FMCG industry . Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region . Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets . Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners . Strong exposure to SAP-based supply chain and logistics operations . Arabic language proficiency . Experience supporting or working closely with a Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director, or senior supply chain leadership .

description:

 Location: Chennai

 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced Treasury Manager / Senior Manager to lead global treasury operations , with strong expertise in Cash Flow Management, Liquidity Planning, Banking Relationship Management and Forex Risk Management . 
 The role will work closely with the Treasury Head, global finance teams, banks, AR and business stakeholders to manage liquidity, optimize working capital, strengthen banking partnerships and effectively manage foreign exchange exposure across a multi-currency, multi-entity global organization. Key Responsibilities 
 Cash Flow & Liquidity Management 
 Lead daily cash positioning, cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning across global entities. Prepare short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts , analyze variances and drive corrective actions. Develop integrated cash flow models covering O2C, P2P, Capex, debtor commitments and working capital . Manage surplus fund deployment, intercompany funding and cross-border fund transfers. Support global cash pooling, funding requirements and liquidity reporting. 
 Banking Relationship Management 
 Manage relationships with global and domestic banking partners . Act as a key point of contact for bank negotiations, pricing, facilities and banking products . Manage banking documentation, KYC and regulatory compliance . Handle credit facilities, bank guarantees, Letters of Credit (LC), factoring and other banking instruments . Liaise with banks for forex deals, rate negotiation and settlement . 
 Forex & Hedging 
 Manage foreign exchange exposure arising from client billing, vendor payments and intercompany transactions. Design and execute Forex Hedging strategies , including forward contracts and other hedging instruments. Monitor forex rates, currency movements and market trends. Partner with business and finance teams on forex exposure, hedging decisions and risk management . Ensure forex and hedging transactions comply with applicable regulatory requirements. 
 Receivables & Working Capital 
 Partner with AR, Billing and Business teams to monitor receivables health and DSO trends. Incorporate receivables and collection trends into cash-flow forecasting and working capital planning. Identify significant overdue exposures and potential cash-flow risks. Coordinate with global AR and finance teams on cross-border invoicing and collection issues having forex or funding implications. 
 Compliance, Controls & Reporting 
 Ensure Treasury operations comply with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Prepare monthly/quarterly Treasury reports covering cash position, forex exposure and banking activities. Support internal and statutory audits related to Treasury, banking and forex. Develop and improve Treasury policies, SOPs, controls and processes . Support Treasury transformation, systems implementation and process standardization initiatives. 
 Desired Candidate Profile 
 15–20 years of progressive experience in Treasury / Cash Management / Corporate Finance. Strong experience in Global Treasury Operations within IT Services, Consulting or another global organization. Proven expertise in Cash Flow Management, Liquidity Planning and Working Capital Management . Strong hands-on experience in Forex Management, Forex Hedging and currency risk management . Experience in Bank Reconciliation, banking operations and global bank relationship management . Strong exposure to US client / US business environment and international transactions . Experience managing banking facilities, KYC, guarantees, LC, factoring and treasury documentation . Experience working with multi-currency and multi-entity global organizations . Exposure to TMS, SAP/Oracle ERP and Advanced Excel is preferred. Candidates currently operating at Manager / Senior Manager / Director-level Treasury responsibilities will be considered for the leadership scope. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical and negotiation skills . CA / MBA Finance / CFA / CTP or equivalent professional qualification preferred. 
 Why This Role? 
 Opportunity to manage Global Treasury operations from India . Direct interaction with global finance teams and banking partners . High-impact role covering Cash, Banking, Forex, Liquidity and Working Capital . Exposure to a multi-currency, multi-entity global business environment . Opportunity to drive Treasury controls, process improvements and strategic initiatives.

title: Embedded Hardware Engineer
description:
EMBEDDED HARDWARE ENGINEER II 
 Who We Are Pinaak Aerial Systems Private Limited is a drone technology startup developing indigenous, mission-configurable UAV platforms for defence applications. We develop flight-control, communication, payload and supporting electronic systems for reliable operation in demanding field environments. 
 About the role As a Hardware Engineer II, you will independently own electronic hardware modules and subsystems for UAV flight controllers, payload systems, communication electronics, power systems and onboard electronicsfrom requirements and circuit design through PCB development, prototype bring-up, validation and production support. The role requires strong hands-on electronics design capability, independent debugging maturity and the ability to resolve complex hardware, power, signal-integrity and hardware–firmware integration issues with limited supervision. This remains a hands-on individual-contributor role. You may guide Engineer I team members on specific designs and debugging activities but will not own organisation-wide hardware architecture or final design authority. 
 Key Responsibilities Independently own hardware modules from requirements, architecture and component selection through schematic, PCB, validation and release. Design analog, digital, mixed-signal, power, communication and microcontroller-based circuits. Select components based on electrical performance, reliability, availability, lifecycle, cost and environmental requirements. Review and guide PCB placement and routing for power integrity, signal integrity, grounding, EMI/EMC, thermal performance and manufacturability. Design interfaces for microcontrollers, sensors, IMUs, GNSS, telemetry/RF modules, storage, ESCs, actuators and payload electronics. Design and validate DC-DC converters, LDOs, power sequencing, protection, battery interfaces and power-distribution circuits. Design and debug UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, ADC, PWM and other high-/low-speed interfaces. Independently perform prototype board bring-up and hardware–firmware integration. Diagnose intermittent and complex hardware failures using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters, current probes and other laboratory equipment. Analyse signal quality, power rails, current consumption, startup behaviour, reset conditions, timing and noise-related issues. Conduct design reviews, schematic reviews and PCB reviews for assigned subsystems. Perform component derating, tolerance analysis and basic worst-case design assessment where required. Support EMI/EMC, temperature, vibration, environmental and reliability testing and resolve failures. Interfaces: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, ADC, PWM, GPIO and board-level communication interfaces. PCB Development: Schematic capture, multilayer PCB design, grounding, impedance considerations, power/signal integrity, DFM/DFT and PCB bring-up. UAV Electronics: Flight controllers, IMUs, GNSS, telemetry/RF modules, ESC interfaces, payload electronics, power distribution and onboard communication systems. Tools: Altium Designer/KiCad/OrCAD or equivalent; oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters, electronic loads, laboratory power supplies and relevant simulation/analysis tools. 
 Required Skills Strong practical knowledge of analog and digital circuit design. Hands-on experience independently designing electronic products or substantial PCB modules. Strong understanding of microcontroller hardware, sensors, communication interfaces and power supplies. Good understanding of schematic design and multilayer PCB design practices. Practical knowledge of grounding, decoupling, EMI/EMC, signal integrity and power integrity. Ability to perform component selection and interpret datasheets beyond reference-design copying. Strong board bring-up and hardware-debugging capability. Ability to independently diagnose complex or intermittent hardware and hardware–firmware integration failures. Understanding of DFM, DFT, component lifecycle and production considerations. Ability to plan validation, assess design risks and determine release readiness for assigned hardware. Strong problem-solving ability, attention to detail and engineering judgement. Clear technical documentation and cross-functional communication skills. 
 Preferred Profile B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical, Instrumentation, Avionics or equivalent. 3–5 years of relevant hardware design and product-development experience. Demonstrated ownership of at least one electronic product or substantial PCB/module from design through validation. Hands-on experience with Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD or equivalent. Experience with MCU-based hardware, sensors, CAN, GNSS, RF/telemetry or power electronics. Experience in UAV, aerospace, robotics, automotive, industrial electronics or other reliability-critical electronic products will be preferred. Exposure to EMI/EMC testing, environmental qualification and production transfer will be advantageous.

description:
Job description

 Experience: 1+ Years

 About the Role 
 We are looking for a highly driven Business Development Manager (BDM) with hands-on experience in SaaS sales, specifically GST Billing / POS software, catering to Retail, F&B;, and FMCG businesses. This is an on-field role where the candidate will manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and product demonstrations to negotiations and deal closure while building strong relationships with business owners and key decision-makers.

Stay updated on GST compliance, billing trends and competitor offerings. Maintain CRM hygiene with accurate and timely updates.

Strong understanding of field sales and local market dynamics. Demonstrated ability to independently close deals. Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated, target-driven and Go-To-Market (GTM) ready mindset. Ability to perform in high-pressure, fast-paced environments. Familiarity with CRM tools and sales tracking systems. 
 Preferred Skills Experience selling subscription-based SaaS products. Knowledge of GST regulations and billing workflows. Existing network in local merchant/business communities. Experience in channel/partner sales is an added advantage.

 Segment: Healthcare/Neutraceutical Segment B2B Sales 
 Job Description: 
 Position Overview: The Healthcare and Nutraceutical Segment a candidate play a crucial role in providing end-to-end service to clients in the nutraceutical industry. This position is responsible for not only building and maintaining strong client relationships but also actively driving sales growth through account management and business development. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture strong relationships with clients in the nutraceutical segment. Understand clients' business objectives, challenges, and opportunities. Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for clients. 2. Needs Assessment: Conduct thorough needs assessments to identify client requirements, Collaborate with the client for presenting Company Portfolio Aligning the Portfolio for Clients requirement present & Future Collaborate with internal/ external teams to tailor solutions that meet the specific needs of each client. 3. Sales and Business Development: Actively seek opportunities for expanding business with existing clients. Identify new Clients and engage with potential clients in the nutraceutical & Healthcare industry to expand the client base. Develop and implement sales strategies to meet and exceed revenue targets. 4. Solution Delivery: Coordinate with cross-functional teams (sales, product development, operations, etc.) to ensure the successful execution of client projects. Provide clients with valuable insights and industry knowledge. 6. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Science Background and additional Degree/ Diploma in (e.g., business, nutrition, or a related discipline). Proven experience in B2B Sales, account management, and business development, preferably in the nutraceutical or healthcare industry. Strong understanding of the nutraceutical market, including industry regulations and trends. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. Problem-solving skills and a customer-focused approach. Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite, Video conferencing on various platforms Benefits: Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Health and wellness benefits. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. A dynamic and collaborative work environment. Travel opportunities to engage with clients as needed.
