title: India - Sales Manager
description:
Who are Inchcape 
 At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. 
 
 We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. 
 
 Main Purpose of Job : Working in a matrix structure and as a member of the Commercial team, the Commercial Manager, India is responsible for growing revenue from the customer base of India. 
 Duties and Responsibilities : 
 Build an understanding of our customers by: - Leveraging industry insights to ensure focus on the customer and how we add value to their business. Ensuring every customer is visited at least every quarter. Ensuring customers are made aware of Inchcape s Products and Services by introducing on (yearly) average, more than 1 product at customer visits and/or as further directed in product sales campaigns in Salesforce. Growing pipeline by at least 4 targets through visiting customers and introducing Inchcape s Products and Services. Create meaningful connections with customers by: - Ensuring alignment between Customers and Inchcape through discipline, transparency, and support across Inchcape s organization. Achieving a win rate of at least 25% Ensuring every customer is retained by selling, on (yearly) average, more than 1 product to owned customers. 
 Ensure Inchcape gets paid fairly and timely by: - Negotiating terms and conditions with customers which support the development of profitable business that achieves or exceeds Inchcape s contracting principles. Leveraging Commercial Policies and Processes on pricing, bids and tenders, contract negotiations, etc., to guarantee compliant execution. Communicate pricing initiatives with customers and ensure Inchcape is at the forefront of providing value to customers. Support the Inchcape Accounts Receivable to collect fees on time, or as escalated for overdue payments. 
 Knowledge : Knowledge of shipping, preferably vessel operations Graduate with reasonable knowledge of IT 
 Skills Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills. Excellent negotiation and influencing abilities. Effective presentation and communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to prioritize workload and manage competing deadlines effectively. 
 
 Experience Master Mariner qualification preferred, with strong understanding of vessel operations, port requirements, and stakeholder expectations. Strong network and relationships with ship owners, operators, charterers, and maritime stakeholders. Ability to confidently represent the organization and promote agency services to potential clients. 
 Qualification Relevant academic qualification - required MBA or higher learning within the Shipping Industry - desirable Multiple languages - desirable 
 Other requirements Ability to travel within India. In exceptional/rare situations, there may be a requirement to travel out of India also. Working knowledge of common IT systems 
 Character and personal qualities : Inchcape s Clarified Personality Assertive, point the way, provide solutions and lead by example Articulate, share expertise, knowledge and opinions with passion and precision Uncomplicated, smooth and efficient service 
 Personal Characteristics Resilience - works well under pressure Social Poise - strong in front of an audience Connects quickly and is comfortable with new people Target Driven Collaborative 
 
 Why Inchcape Shipping Services We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. 
 Our values are at the cente of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture. 
 The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships. 
 Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry. 
 In return, we will offer you: A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive: - A retirement savings plan - Life assurance - Holiday - Competitive salary - Employee Assistance Programme - Career development and progression opportunities - Values Award celebration events 
 Plus, much more! 
 If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!

Coordinate with technology, learning, accessibility, project management and other internal teams to ensure proposals are accurate and complete. Manage bid timelines, actions and dependencies using Smartsheet or similar bid/project management tools. Ensure proposals meet submission deadlines, client requirements and internal quality standards. Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of experience in RFP Management, Bid Management, Proposal Management, Pre-Sales or Solutioning. Experience working on eLearning, digital learning, EdTech, digital content or educational technology projects. Strong understanding of the digital learning/eLearning ecosystem. Experience in preparing technical proposals, solution approaches, methodologies and compliance responses. Experience with LOE estimation, WBS, resource planning, costing, pricing and commercial proposals. Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including complex estimation and pricing models. title: Merchandise Manager
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE 
 We make in China and in India, and we carry roughly sixty days between paying for inventory and selling it. That number is the single most expensive fact about our business. Every week a shipment slips, every carton that arrives wrong, every clearance that stalls at customs, comes straight out of it. 
 This role exists to protect that. You will work directly , who owns supplier sourcing and production, and you will run the tracking layer underneath him. Where every open order actually is, against where it was promised. What is needed for it to clear customs and land at the Delhi office. What we check before we accept it. When something is going to be late, you are the person who knows first and says so early, while there is still time to do something about it. 
 It is a detail role and it is unglamorous, and it is also the job that decides whether 125 SKUs are on the shelf when a campaign goes live. You should be the kind of person who finds a quiet satisfaction in a clean checklist and an honest tracker. 
 What you'll own The live production tracker across every open order, India and China, against committed dates Import and compliance documentation. Invoices, packing lists, BOE, HS classification, customs paperwork, and the coordination that gets a container cleared without a scramble The QC protocol. Building the inspection checklist per product, running pre-dispatch and inward checks, and holding the line when a batch does not meet it Defect logging and the loop back to the supplier, so the same fault does not arrive twice Packaging and consumables availability alongside , so a finished good never waits on a box The weekly production status report the founders and the warehouse plan against Inward coordination with operations team, so what lands is what the system expects 
 What we're looking for 3 to 6 years in production, merchandising, sourcing or supply chain for a physical product brand. Bags, leather goods, accessories, hard goods or apparel You have tracked live orders against dates and chased suppliers who were slipping. This is the core of the job Working knowledge of Indian import: customs documentation, duty, HS codes, freight forwarders, clearance timelines You can write and run a QC checklist, and you are comfortable rejecting a batch Genuinely strong in Excel or Sheets. Trackers, pivots, reconciliation Organised, direct, and hard to fluster. Suppliers will tell you what you want to hear, and you will need to check 
 Nice to have You have worked with Chinese suppliers and know how that communication actually goes Experience with an ERP or inventory system such as Unicommerce You have been part of moving production from one country to another

Key Skills: Merchant Activities,Merchandising Strategies,Merchandise Planning,Online Merchandising,Retail Merchandising,Merchandising,Planning,Management

Job Description MIS Executive Cum Stock Auditor Job Title MIS Executive Cum Stock Auditor Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical MIS Executive Cum Stock Auditor responsible for preparing MIS reports, maintaining accurate data, monitoring inventory records, and conducting regular stock audits. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Willingness and ability to travel for audit assignments is mandatory. Reduction of inventory-related errors and losses. Experience: 1–3 years

title: General Manager - HR Operations & Business Management
description:
Job Description Role Overview We are looking for a results-driven, strategic, and hands-on General Manager HR, Operations & Business Management to lead our India operations and support the company's regional and international growth. This is a leadership role that goes beyond traditional HR. The position will be responsible for HR strategy, resource management, workforce planning, employee retention, payroll, operational coordination, performance management, business analysis, cost optimization, and organizational scalability . The ideal candidate should be able to understand business requirements, assess resource capacity, identify gaps, improve utilization, build high-performing teams, and ensure the right people are available at the right time to support business growth. You will work closely with the leadership team and coordinate across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and HR to build a scalable and accountable organization. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic HR & Business Leadership Develop and execute integrated HR and operational strategies aligned with business objectives. Work closely with leadership to understand business growth plans and translate them into workforce and operational requirements. Support the company's expansion across India, the UK, Ireland, and future international markets. Build scalable HR, people, and operational frameworks suitable for a fast-growing SaaS/technology business. Participate in strategic business planning, organizational restructuring, and workforce decisions. Identify organizational bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve business efficiency. 2. Workforce & Resource Management Analyse business requirements, workload, revenue targets, and operational capacity to determine resource requirements. Develop workforce plans based on business scale, growth projections, and departmental requirements. Identify resource shortages and coordinate internal movements, hiring, cross-training, and allocation to fill critical gaps. Monitor resource utilization, productivity, availability, and capacity across departments. Identify under-utilized resources and recommend appropriate reallocation or development plans. Build a resource planning framework to ensure the organization can scale efficiently without unnecessary manpower costs. Conduct regular resource requirement reviews with department heads and leadership. 3. Resource Value Proposition & Cost Optimization Conduct resource value proposition analysis to understand the business contribution, cost, productivity, and strategic value of employees and teams. Analyse manpower cost against revenue, productivity, workload, and business outcomes. Identify opportunities to improve resource utilization and operational efficiency. Support leadership in making data-driven decisions on hiring, restructuring, internal movement, outsourcing, and resource allocation. Develop manpower cost and productivity dashboards for management review. 4. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning Lead hiring strategy across India based on current and future business requirements. Build strong talent pipelines for Sales, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, HR, and other functions. Improve hiring quality, turnaround time, candidate experience, and onboarding effectiveness. Work with department heads to define manpower requirements and job specifications. Establish structured recruitment processes and hiring KPIs. Support cross-border workforce planning and international hiring coordination. Ensure new hires are aligned with business requirements, team structure, and long-term growth plans. 5. Employee Retention & Career Growth Develop and implement a long-term employee retention strategy . Identify key reasons for employee attrition and implement measurable corrective actions. Establish career growth frameworks and clearly defined career paths across departments. Work with managers to create individual development and progression plans for employees. Develop internal mobility and promotion frameworks to retain high-performing employees. Conduct regular employee feedback, engagement, and retention reviews. Identify critical and high-value resources and develop appropriate retention strategies. Build a culture where employees understand their career opportunities, responsibilities, and growth expectations. 6. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Establish and manage complete employee lifecycle processes from onboarding to exit. Develop and maintain HR policies, SOPs, processes, and documentation. Ensure effective onboarding, probation management, confirmation, transfers, promotions, disciplinary processes, and exits. Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation. Improve HR process automation and reduce manual administrative work. Manage attendance, leave, shift structures, employee records, and HR reporting. Ensure HR processes are consistent, transparent, and aligned with company policies. 7. Zoho Payroll & HR Systems Own and manage the effective implementation and usage of Zoho Payroll and related HR systems . Ensure accurate payroll processing, attendance integration, leave management, deductions, reimbursements, and employee records. Coordinate with Finance and HR teams to ensure payroll accuracy and timely processing. Identify opportunities to automate HR and payroll processes. Maintain appropriate payroll controls, reports, approvals, and audit trails. Ensure HRMS data is accurate and up to date. 8. KRA, KPI & Performance Management Establish and implement effective KRA/KPI frameworks across departments. Work with department heads to define measurable KRAs aligned with business objectives. Ensure employees understand their responsibilities, targets, and expected outcomes. Establish regular KRA follow-up and performance review mechanisms. Track individual and team performance against defined KPIs. Identify performance gaps and coordinate improvement plans. Support managers in conducting structured performance reviews. Link performance, career growth, incentives, and development plans wherever appropriate. 9. Internal Team Coordination & Operational Support Act as a central coordination point between HR, Operations, Sales, Technology, Product, Finance, and Customer Success. Ensure effective communication and coordination between departments. Identify operational dependencies and resolve resource-related bottlenecks. Support department heads in managing workload and resource requirements. Coordinate internal resources during peak workloads, critical projects, migrations, launches, and business priorities. Ensure teams have adequate resources to meet business commitments. Improve cross-functional accountability and execution discipline. 10. Business Analysis & Resource Planning Analyse business performance and translate business growth into manpower and operational requirements. Review revenue, workload, productivity, staffing levels, and resource capacity. Develop resource forecasts based on business growth and future requirements. Prepare management reports covering manpower, productivity, cost, attrition, hiring, and resource utilization. title: Digital media Content Creator
description:
1. JOB DESCRIPTION 
 DIGITAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATOR Location: Chennai Ekkaduthangal / Thiruvanmiyur
 Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site
 Travel: Within Tamil Nadu, across India and Middle East as required Position Overview We are looking for a young, creative and energetic Digital Media Content Creator who can create engaging visual content for the Founders personal brand as well as the company’s digital and social media platforms. This is a hands-on content creation role. The successful candidate should be comfortable working behind the camera, shooting videos using smartphones, identifying interesting camera angles and capturing real-life business, leadership, lifestyle, corporate and event-based content. The individual should have a good understanding of how content differs across platforms, particularly Instagram and LinkedIn, and should be capable of researching trends, developing new content ideas and converting everyday activities, business events and experiences into engaging digital content. Key Responsibilities Shoot high-quality videos and photographs primarily using smartphones and other available camera equipment. Understand and apply appropriate camera angles, framing, composition, lighting and movement while shooting. Shoot short-form vertical videos suitable for Instagram Reels, Stories and other social media formats. Shoot professional business, leadership, educational and corporate-style videos suitable for LinkedIn. Create content for both the Founder’s personal social media presence and the company’s official digital platforms. Accompany the Founder and/or company team for meetings, events, business activities, site visits, conferences and other content opportunities when required. Identify interesting moments and opportunities for content creation instead of depending entirely on instructions. Research Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other online platforms to identify relevant trends, topics, formats and content ideas. Develop creative concepts and suggest new ideas for Reels, short videos, interviews, educational content, business content and personal-brand storytelling. Understand the difference between personal-brand content, corporate content and platform-specific content. Assist in planning content shoots, locations, shot sequences and basic storyboards where required. Work closely with the Founder and management team to understand the intended message and convert ideas into engaging visual content. Organise and maintain photographs, video footage and other digital media systematically. Coordinate with social media, design and editing resources where required to ensure captured content is converted into high-quality finished material. Basic video editing capability will be an advantage. Stay updated with evolving social media trends, content formats, mobile videography techniques and digital content tools. Be flexible with working hours when content needs to be captured outside regular office timings, during events or while travelling. Be willing to travel within Chennai, Tamil Nadu, across India and internationally, particularly to the Middle East, when business requirements demand. What We Are Looking For We are not looking only for someone who knows how to operate a camera. We want someone who is curious, observant and creative — someone who can look at a location, business meeting, journey, event or everyday experience and think: “There is a good piece of content here. How can we capture it?” The role offers significant exposure to entrepreneurship, business, leadership, personal branding, digital media and content creation across India and the Middle East. 
 2. CANDIDATE PROFILE 
 CANDIDATE PROFILE – DIGITAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATOR We are looking for a young, energetic and creative individual who is passionate about videography, social media and digital content creation. Preferred Candidate Profile Male or female candidates may apply. Ideally between 18 and 30 years of age . Must be based in Chennai or willing to relocate to Chennai. This is a full-time, on-site position and is not a hybrid or work-from-home role. Work location will primarily be Ekkaduthangal or Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai , depending on business requirements. Educational qualification is not a priority . Practical talent, creativity, attitude, dedication and willingness to learn are more important than academic qualifications. Should have good practical skills in shooting videos using smartphones. Should understand camera angles, framing, composition, lighting and basic visual storytelling. Should be comfortable shooting Instagram Reels and short-form vertical content. Should be capable of shooting professional business and corporate-style videos suitable for LinkedIn. Should have a good understanding of Instagram, LinkedIn and other major social media platforms. Should be capable of researching online and independently generating ideas for new content. Interest in photography, videography, filmmaking, social media, digital marketing or content creation is strongly preferred. Basic video editing knowledge using tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar applications will be an advantage. Knowledge of Canva, AI tools and emerging content-creation technologies will be an additional advantage. title: Marketing Executive
description:
Sales & Marketing Enterprise Business Automation Solutions 
 Role Overview 
 Company: Vorizo Infotech India Pvt. Ltd. Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time Experience: Freshers to Experienced Professionals Work Modes: On-Field Sales and Inside Sales Compensation: As per industry standards plus attractive performance incentives 
 Vorizo Infotech India Pvt. Ltd. is building a one-stop enterprise IT solutions business that helps organizations automate, integrate and digitally transform their operations. 
 We provide software products, implementation services, customised solutions, system integration, support and business process automation across Finance, Accounting, Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Management, CRM, HR, Payroll, Taxation, Fixed Assets and Business Intelligence. 
 We are seeking ambitious and customer-focused Sales & Marketing Executives and Managers to help businesses identify the right technology solutions for their needs. This role involves engaging with business leaders, understanding operational challenges and recommending solutions that improve productivity, control costs, strengthen decision-making and support growth. 
 Solution Portfolio 
 Our enterprise technology portfolio includes: 
 - Tally / TallyPrime - SAP Business One - Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central - Oracle NetSuite - SAP ERP / Enterprise Solutions - Oracle Solutions - CRM Solutions - HR & Payroll Solutions - Direct & Indirect Tax Solutions - Fixed Asset Management Solutions - Business Intelligence and MIS Reporting - Customised Software Solutions - System Integration and Automation Solutions 
 Our solutions support the complete business lifecycle: 
 Finance & Accounting Inventory Sales Purchase Order Management CRM HR Payroll Taxation Fixed Assets MIS & BI Reporting 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead Generation and Business Development 
 - Identify, research and develop new business opportunities. - Generate leads through field visits, telephone, email, LinkedIn, networking and other channels. - Build relationships with business owners, CFOs, Finance Heads, HR Heads, IT Heads and senior management. - Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline. - Conduct structured follow-ups and convert qualified prospects into customers. - Build a consultative and value-focused sales approach. 
 Requirement Understanding 
 - Understand customer processes, challenges, priorities and growth plans. - Identify requirements across Finance, Accounting, Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Management, CRM, HR, Payroll, Taxation, Fixed Assets and Business Intelligence. - Translate business challenges into clear solution opportunities. - Coordinate with technical and functional teams for detailed requirement analysis. 
 Solution Selling 
 - Recommend suitable software and technology solutions based on customer requirements. - Position solutions such as Tally, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Oracle and customised applications. - Explain business benefits, return on investment, automation capabilities, scalability and long-term value. - Conduct or coordinate product demonstrations. - Prepare proposals and support commercial discussions with management. - Sell business outcomes and transformation rather than features alone. 
 End-to-End Sales Management 
 Manage and support the complete sales cycle: 
 Lead Generation Qualification Requirement Analysis Product Presentation Demo Proposal Negotiation Closure Implementation Handover Customer Relationship 
 Customer Relationship Management 
 - Build trusted, long-term customer relationships. - Identify opportunities for upgrades, additional modules, integrations and customised solutions. - Coordinate with implementation and support teams to ensure a smooth customer experience. - Contribute to customer retention, satisfaction and account growth. 
 Channel and Referral Development 
 - Build relationships with CAs, CFOs, consultants, IT consultants, business networks and referral partners. - Develop strategic alliances that generate enterprise software opportunities. - Participate in exhibitions, seminars, networking events and business meetings. 
 Work Modes 
 On-Field Sales 
 Responsibilities include: 
 - Meeting customers and prospects. - Developing new business opportunities. - Conducting enterprise meetings. - Generating and qualifying leads. - Coordinating product presentations. - Building customer relationships. - Following up on proposals and commercial discussions. - Driving opportunities toward closure. 
 This mode is ideal for professionals who enjoy meeting people, understanding businesses, building networks and creating opportunities through direct engagement. 
 Inside Sales 
 Responsibilities include: 
 - Calling and qualifying leads. - Generating new business opportunities. - Conducting online product presentations. - Managing structured follow-ups. - Maintaining accurate CRM records. - Generating appointments for sales meetings. - Coordinating proposals and demonstrations. - Supporting field sales activities. - Managing customer communication and relationship development. 
 This mode is ideal for confident communicators who are organized, digitally comfortable and motivated by building a strong sales pipeline through remote engagement. 
 Candidate Requirements 
 We are looking for candidates with: 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills. - Confidence in interacting with business owners and senior decision-makers. - Good interpersonal and relationship-building abilities. - Genuine interest in sales, technology and business development. - Curiosity to understand business operations and technology solutions. - Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development. - A target-oriented, disciplined and self-motivated approach. - Ability to understand business requirements and identify relevant solutions. - Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience in any of the following areas will be an advantage: 
 - Tally / TallyPrime - SAP Business One or SAP ERP - Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central - Oracle NetSuite or Oracle ERP - ERP, CRM or HRMS - Payroll or taxation software - Fixed Asset Management - Business Intelligence or MIS - IT services and software sales - B2B or enterprise sales 
 Candidates who have sold ERP, Accounting, CRM, HRMS or other enterprise software solutions will be preferred. 
 Freshers 
 Freshers with strong communication skills, confidence, enthusiasm, learning agility and a genuine interest in technology sales are encouraged to apply. 
 Product and solution orientation will be provided to help candidates understand our offerings, customer needs and consultative sales process. With the right attitude and consistent performance, freshers can progress into sales, account management or business consulting roles. 
 Benefits and Growth Opportunities 
 - Work across multiple enterprise software and IT solutions. - Gain exposure to leading ERP, CRM and business automation platforms. - Learn about Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, CRM, HR, Payroll, Tax, Fixed Assets and Business Intelligence. - Work with SMEs and enterprise customers. - Gain exposure to product sales, implementation, integration and customised solutions. - Learn through customer interactions and collaboration with technical and functional teams. - Earn attractive performance-based incentives. - Receive recognition and growth opportunities for consistent performance. - Progress based on capability, ownership and results. - Build a career in enterprise technology sales and business consulting. - Make a visible impact by helping businesses improve efficiency, control and growth. 
 Why Join Vorizo Infotech? 
 This is not a traditional single-product sales role. You will learn to understand a customer’s complete business requirements and recommend the right technology solution for their specific needs. 
 You will have the opportunity to: 
 - Develop expertise across multiple enterprise technology platforms. - Understand how different business functions operate and connect. - Work directly with business owners and senior decision-makers. - Build consultative selling, negotiation and relationship-management skills. - Contribute to projects that improve organizational efficiency. - Progress from lead generation and sales execution into account management, consulting or leadership roles. - Earn attractive incentives by creating measurable business value. 
 Our approach is: 
 Understand the Business Identify the Problem Recommend the Right Technology Implement Integrate Customise Support Grow with the Customer 
 Application Details 
 Company: Vorizo Infotech India Pvt. Ltd. Position: Sales & Marketing – Enterprise IT Solutions Experience: Freshers and Experienced Professionals Location: Hyderabad Work Modes: On-Field Sales and Inside Sales Employment Type: Full-Time Compensation: As per industry standards plus performance incentives 
 If you are passionate about Sales, Technology, ERP and Business Automation, and want a role where your learning, performance and contribution can shape your career, we would like to hear from you.

title: Documentation and Accounts Executive
description:
We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Documentation and Accounts Executive to support the Managing Director with documentation, financial records, MIS, and day-to-day accounting activities. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate documentation, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring timely preparation and submission of financial information. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. MD Documentation & Coordination Maintain and organize important documents, records, agreements, letters, and reports for the Managing Director. Prepare and maintain files, trackers, MIS reports, and management documents as required. Coordinate with various departments for information/documents required by the MD. Prepare summaries, statements, presentations, and reports for management review. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive financial and business information. Track pending documents, approvals, payments, and other management-level requirements. Coordinate follow-ups with internal teams, vendors, customers, consultants, and other stakeholders as required.

Verify expense claims and supporting documents before processing. Coordinate with internal teams regarding pending bills, advances, expenses, and supporting documents. Maintain proper filing and documentation of accounting records. 
 Required Skills Good knowledge of Tally/ERP and MS Excel . Strong knowledge of basic accounting principles. Good understanding of GST and TDS documentation. Good documentation and record-management skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good coordination and follow-up skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS and basic MIS preparation , will be preferred. 
 Qualification B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / equivalent qualification. 24 years of relevant experience in Accounts, Finance, MIS, or Management/MD office coordination. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Experience in handling accounts along with management/MD documentation . Should be systematic, responsible, and highly organized. Should have good follow-up and coordination abilities. Should be comfortable handling confidential financial and business information.

title: B2B Collection Executive
description:
Position Overview The Collection Executive plays a critical role in managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely payments, and maintaining strong commercial relationships with corporate and enterprise clients. Operating within the B2B pest management sector, this role bridges finance and customer service, requiring a balance of persistence, professionalism, and industry-specific awareness of service-level agreements (SLAs). Key Responsibilities * Accounts Receivable Management: Monitor client accounts to identify overdue invoices and outstanding balances across a diverse B2B portfolio (commercial, industrial, hospitality, and corporate clients). * Payment Follow-ups & Reminders: Proactively communicate with client accounts payable departments via phone, email, and virtual meetings to secure timely payments in accordance with agreed credit terms. * Dispute & Query Resolution: Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, service delivery disputes, or missing documentation (such as service completion reports, digitally signed job cards, or vendor portal entry issues) in coordination with operations and service teams. * Aging Report Analysis: Regularly review and report on the Accounts Receivable (AR) aging bucket, providing management with accurate cash flow projections and risk assessments for delayed payments. * Receipt Reconciliation & Documentation: Accurately post and reconcile incoming payments against respective invoices, maintaining up-to-date ledger records and issuing official receipts or statements of account. * Credit Control Support: Assist in evaluating the creditworthiness of new B2B clients and help enforce company credit policies to minimize bad debt. Required Qualifications & Skills * Education: Bachelors degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. * Experience: 2 to 4 years of proven experience in B2B debt recovery, accounts receivable, or corporate collections—preferably within the service industry, facility management, or allied B2B sectors. * Communication & Negotiation: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities to resolve payment bottlenecks while preserving client relationships. * Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Zoho, or Tally) and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, aging schedules). * Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with service-based billing cycles, digital invoicing portals, and vendor payment approval workflows commonly used by corporate clients. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Days Sales Outstanding (DSO): Reduction and maintenance of average collection periods. * Collection Efficiency Ratio (CER): Percentage of total receivables collected within the targeted billing cycle. * Aging Portfolio Management: Minimization of overdue balances sitting in the 60+ and 90+ day aging buckets. * Dispute Resolution Time: Speed and accuracy in resolving billing queries to unblock pending payments.

description:
Head Finance & Accounts Goodman Vetcare Pvt. Ltd. is a growing animal healthcare business operating across pet retail and e-commerce through Animeal , veterinary medicines, veterinary medical instruments and equipment, and B2B animal healthcare. As the business continues to grow and prepares for future fundraising, we are looking for an experienced Head – Finance & Accounts who can take ownership of the finance and accounting function and build strong financial controls across the organisation. The role will work closely with the Founder/Directors and manage the existing accounts team. Key Responsibilities Take overall responsibility for accounts, finance, taxation and statutory compliance . Supervise day-to-day accounting, reconciliations and month-end/year-end closure. Manage GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances , including timely filings and reconciliations. Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, banks and other external professionals. Lead preparation for statutory audits, tax audits and internal audits . Prepare accurate monthly MIS, P&L, Balance Sheet, cash-flow reports and management dashboards . Develop and monitor annual budgets, forecasts and department-wise expenditure . Track receivables, payables, working capital and cash-flow requirements. Maintain daily visibility of bank balances, collections, payments and major financial commitments . Strengthen internal controls, approval processes and financial discipline across the organisation. Review vendor/customer reconciliations and resolve accounting discrepancies. Support management in pricing, margins, profitability and business decision-making. Ensure books and documentation are maintained in a manner suitable for investor and lender due diligence . Assist in preparation of financial information, schedules, reports and documentation required during fundraising, due diligence and investor discussions . Coordinate across multiple businesses/entities and provide consolidated financial information to the Directors. Lead, train and review the existing accounts team. Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially aware and strong on compliance , rather than someone who only supervises accounting from a distance. The ideal candidate should have: 7–12 years of relevant Finance & Accounts experience. Strong practical knowledge of GST, TDS, taxation, audits and statutory compliance . Experience preparing and reviewing P&L, Balance Sheet, cash-flow statements and MIS . Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and working-capital management . Excellent Excel skills and experience with accounting/ERP systems. Experience dealing directly with auditors, consultants, banks and government authorities. Ability to manage multiple companies/entities and supervise an accounts team. Strong attention to detail, ownership and ability to work independently. Experience in a growing company, startup, retail, e-commerce, healthcare, pharma or distribution environment would be useful. Qualification: CA / CMA preferred. Strong CA Inter, M.Com or MBA-Finance candidates with substantial hands-on experience may also be considered. The role is suited for professionals who enjoy problem-solving, financial analysis, MIS, financial reporting and working on different assignments for different clients , rather than performing repetitive month-on-month finance activities for a single organization. Our team works with clients on robust MIS, financial statements, financial reporting, audit coordination and various special financial/consulting assignments.

Analysis of financial performance, profitability, working capital and key business metrics. Supporting clients in improving financial reporting and management information systems. Coordination with statutory auditors and assisting clients in getting audits completed. Understanding client businesses and translating financial information into meaningful management insights. Preparation of various financial databases, schedules, reports and special-purpose documents. Working on special assignments/projects for multiple clients. Supporting senior team members in client meetings and presentations. Handling multiple clients/assignments and managing timelines simultaneously. Identifying inconsistencies, gaps and unusual trends in financial information. Developing an understanding of different business models and industries through client exposure.

title: Actuarial Associate Manager
description:
The Role The Actuarial Associate Manager is responsibility to manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial projects across reserving, pricing, capital, risk modelling and financial reporting. The role combines hands-on actuarial expertise with technical review, project management, client engagement and day-to-day guidance of a small team or project workstream. You will apply sound actuarial judgement to data, methods, assumptions, models and conclusions; ensure high-quality and timely delivery; explain findings clearly to clients and senior colleagues; and build team capability through coaching, feedback and knowledge sharing. What You Will Do Actuarial Project Delivery Manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial assignments across P&C reserving, pricing and insurance optimisation, captive capital and Solvency II, risk financing, and financial reporting. Define and manage scope, workplans, timelines, budgets, dependencies and quality checkpoints for small to medium projects or workstreams within larger engagements. Prepare and oversee forward-looking loss forecasts, reserve analyses, capital assessments and other bespoke actuarial models for corporate and captive insurance clients. Interpret model outputs, investigate movements and translate technical results into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Technical Review and Quality Assurance Perform independent technical and editorial review of data, methodologies, assumptions, calculations, models and client deliverables, applying reasonableness checks and actuarial judgement. Ensure work is accurate, reproducible, appropriately documented and compliant with applicable professional, regulatory and internal standards. Resolve routine and moderately complex technical issues using established methods and prior experience, escalating novel or higher-risk matters when appropriate. Maintain clear review evidence and support continuous improvement of templates, controls and quality frameworks. Lead or contribute substantively to client calls, meetings, workshops and presentations, explaining actuarial methods, findings, limitations and recommendations in accessible language. Work collaboratively with colleagues across geographies and disciplines, coordinating inputs and ensuring effective information exchange. Team Leadership and Capability Building Coordinate the daily activities of analysts and senior analysts on assigned engagements, allocate work and monitor progress against agreed plans. Coach colleagues, answer technical queries and provide timely, constructive feedback that improves actuarial judgement, communication and delivery quality. Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute to a cooperative, inclusive environment that encourages technical development and shared learning. Support resource planning, workload prioritisation, onboarding and development discussions for the immediate team. Core Areas of Work Area / Typical responsibilities P&C Pricing and Optimisation - Loss forecasting, insurance programme analysis, risk transfer optimisation and strategic recommendations. P&C Reserving - Reserving analysis, movement investigation, methods and assumptions, report writing and clear presentation of conclusions. Capital and Solvency II - Profitability and financial strength assessment for captives, review of SCR and technical provisions, assumption challenge and regulatory support. Bespoke Analytics -Risk financing, modelling tools, scenario analysis, automation, research and multidisciplinary risk projects. Experience and Qualifications Recognised degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering or another highly numerate discipline. A minimum of 8 out of 13 actuarial examinations completed toward a recognised actuarial qualification. At least 5 years of relevant actuarial experience, including experience in one or more of P&C reserving, pricing, capital, risk financing, captive insurance or financial reporting. Experience managing project delivery or workstreams, reviewing actuarial work and guiding junior colleagues. Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise reports and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Technical Tools Strong Microsoft Office capability is required. Proficiency in at least one relevant analytical or actuarial tool is expected, such as R/R Shiny, Python, Power BI, RADAR, Igloo or ResQ. The successful candidate should be able to select fit-for-purpose tools, review outputs critically and support reproducible analysis. This description outlines the principal responsibilities of the role. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, client demand and the development of the successful candidate.

title: Service Desk Quality Analyst
description:
OVERVIEW 
The Service Desk Quality Analyst supports the Service Desk operation by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of ticket handling and documentation. While this role primarily operates behind the scenes, it may occasionally involve handling service tickets to support operational needs or gain deeper insight into service patterns. Key responsibilities include reviewing ticket coding for accuracy, interpreting dashboards, identifying recurring issues, and converting data into actionable insights for service leads. Tasks involve auditing tickets, flagging miscategorized entries, reporting on Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, monitoring backlog trends, and assisting problem management through thorough data analysis. Acting as an extension of the quality function, this role plays a critical part in enhancing ticket hygiene, improving team performance, and delivering operational insights that drive continuous service desk improvements.
 DESCRIPTION The Service Desk Quality Analyst is a mid-level role that works closely with the Service Desk team and leadership to: Monitor incoming new tickets in the Service Desk system to ensure timely and accurate assignment to the appropriate team members Monitor incoming escalations to promptly identify high-priority or complex issues requiring immediate attention from Senior Analysts or Service Desk management Maintain real-time oversight of ticket queues and escalation paths to prevent bottlenecks and service delays Provide backup support to Service Desk Analysts by handling tickets as needed during peak periods, absences, or resource shortages, helping maintain consistent service levels Review and audit service desk tickets for coding accuracy and categorization Identify and flag misclassified or incomplete entries Monitor SLA compliance and generate weekly/monthly performance reports Analyze incident and request trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or documentation improvements Track backlog trends and report on resolution times Provide support in problem management by conducting comprehensive, data-driven root cause analysis Interpret dashboards and translate technical data into clear, actionable insights for service improvement Contribute to quality improvement initiatives by highlighting gaps and supporting process documentation Use dashboards (e.g., Zoho ManageEngine, ServiceNow, Jira) to extract performance insights Assist with the standardization of ticket documentation practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency in incident reporting and documentation Full-time role with rotational shifts based on business requirements Collaborate with Service Desk leads and quality teams to translate data insights into actionable recommendations Assist in documenting known issues, process updates, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives Participate in team meetings and quality reviews, sharing insights that help drive service enhancements Track and analyze the volume and types of escalations to identify training needs for Service Desk staff Complete all other tasks deemed appropriate for the role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS Process Documentation skills Advanced Excel skills Ability to deep dive into numbers and draw conclusions Understanding of Root Cause Analysis Strong reasoning and analytical skills Time Management and prioritization Multi-tasking capabilities Ability to manage several priorities at once Ability to focus for long periods of time to determine a solution Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) Organize thoughts and communicate verbal messages appropriately to listeners and situations Demonstrated proficiency in grammar and typing skills Comfortable with repetitive tasks Good attention to detail and willingness to learn Ability to work independently Willingness to cooperate with others and work for the greater good. 
 REQUIRED EXPEREINCE & QUALIFICATIONS A year of phone, email, or chat support experience in IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, Technical Support, or US customer support experience Two years of data analysis and reporting or a Bachelors degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field Familiar with ITIL and its processes, specifically those related to Service Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management Knowledge of Customer Service principles and practices Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., Zoho Manage Engine, ServiceNow, Jira) Understanding of SLA metrics Experience in process documentation 
 DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Analytics / Data analysis and reporting in a Call Center or Service Desk environment Work experience in the Pharma industry Knowledge of computer fundamentals, software/web application Strong troubleshooting skills.

title: Manager - Credit Risk
description:
About bluCognition bluCognition is an AI-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150+ lenders with AI-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first-party fraud. Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe. 
 About the Role We are looking for a Manager Credit Risk to lead credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will combine hands-on credit expertise, client management, solution development and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong financial analysis and commercial credit underwriting expertise, sound credit judgment, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical processes and solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead delivery of credit risk, underwriting and risk consulting engagements, ensuring quality, timelines and client requirements are met. Perform and review financial and credit analysis, including financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flows, liquidity, leverage, profitability, working capital, AR/AP aging and other key credit indicators. Monitor credit portfolios and risk trends, identifying emerging risks, changes in financial performance and other indicators requiring attention, and communicate relevant insights to clients. Conduct quantitative and qualitative credit assessment, including business model, industry, customer concentration, debt obligations, contracts and supporting documentation, to identify key risks and form a credit view. Own client communication and requirement gathering, translating business needs into underwriting frameworks, processes, SOPs and practical risk/technology solutions. Manage and develop internal team, including work allocation, quality review, coaching and capability building.  What we are looking for 5 years of experience in commercial credit risk, financial analysis or risk consulting, preferably within banking, lending, fintech or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred. Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, credit appraisal, ratio analysis, cash-flow and working-capital assessment, with sound credit judgment. Strong credit judgment and attention to detail, including ability to identify financial, operational and qualitative risks from multiple information sources. Excellent client-facing, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand ambiguous requirements and develop practical solutions. Experience managing/reviewing junior team members and taking ownership of project delivery. Experience with process design, SOP development, automation or analytics initiatives. title: Accounts Executive
description:
Job Title: Accounts Executive / Healthcare Accounts Executive 
 Department: Finance & Accounts 
 Industry: Healthcare / Hospital 
 Job Location: B R Health Care Rohini Hospital, Delhi 
 Job Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting and financial activities of the hospital. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, billing-related accounting, cash and bank transactions, vendor payments, reconciliations, and supporting the management in financial reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Maintain day-to-day accounting records and financial transactions. - Handle hospital billing-related accounting and revenue records. - Prepare and maintain cash and bank books. - Manage daily cash collections and deposits. - Perform bank and ledger reconciliations. - Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records. - Process vendor bills and maintain vendor accounts. - Verify invoices, bills, receipts, and supporting documents. - Prepare payment vouchers, receipts, and journal entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. - Coordinate with the billing, TPA, Ayushman, pharmacy, purchase, and administration departments for accounts-related matters. - Monitor outstanding payments and receivables. - Assist in salary and payroll-related accounting. - Maintain records related to PF, ESI, TDS, GST and other statutory requirements. - Assist in preparation of monthly financial reports and MIS. - Support internal and external audits by providing required documents and records. - Identify accounting discrepancies and coordinate for timely correction. - Ensure compliance with hospital financial policies and accounting procedures. - Maintain confidentiality of financial and employee information. - Perform any other accounts-related duties assigned by management. 
 Required Skills 
 - Good knowledge of accounting principles and practices. - Knowledge of hospital/healthcare billing and accounts will be preferred. - Good knowledge of MS Excel. - Knowledge of Tally/ERP/accounting software. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy. - Ability to maintain confidential financial records. - Good time-management and organizational skills. 
 Qualification 
 - B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification. - Candidates with relevant hospital accounts experience will be preferred. 
 Experience 
 - 15 years of relevant experience in Accounts. - Experience in a hospital/healthcare organization will be an added advantage. 
 Key Competencies 
 - Accuracy & attention to detail - Financial record management - Reconciliation skills - MS Excel - Tally/ERP - Communication & coordination - Problem-solving - Confidentiality and integrity 
 Salary 
 Salary: As per candidate's experience and skills. 
 Working Hours

 The selected candidate will report to the Accounts/Finance Head and Hospital Management.

description:
Job Title: U.S. Accountant / Tax Associate / Tax Manager 
 Location: Shalimar Bagh, Delhi , India
 Employment Type & Shift: Full-Time and US Shift 08:00 PM IST to 05:00 AM IST 
 Experience: 2 - 10 Years of Relevant U.S. Tax Experience / Min. 5 yrs. in US Accouning
 Industry: U.S. CPA Firm / Tax & Accounting Services
 Reporting To: Head Finance & Operations 
 About the Role We are a U.S.-based CPA firm with a professional team working from India, providing U.S. tax preparation, compliance, accounting, and advisory services to individuals and businesses across the United States. 
 We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented U.S. Accountant /Tax Associate / Tax Manager with 2 - 10 years of hands-on experience in U.S. taxation . The ideal candidate should have practical experience preparing and/or reviewing U.S. federal and state tax returns and be comfortable working with U.S. tax software and accounting records. 
 Key Responsibilities Prepare and review U.S. federal and state income tax returns. Work on individual and business tax returns, including: Form 1040 Form 1065 Form 1120 Form 1120-S Related federal and state tax forms and schedules. Prepare tax work papers and supporting schedules. Review financial statements, trial balances, general ledgers, and other accounting records for tax preparation. Identify potential tax issues, missing information, and tax adjustments. Perform tax research and assist with resolving technical tax matters. Assist with federal and state tax compliance requirements. Communicate with U.S.-based clients and/or the firm's U.S. tax team regarding tax-related information and queries. Assist in preparing responses to IRS and state notices, as required. Maintain proper documentation and follow the firm's tax preparation and review procedures. Meet assigned deadlines and manage multiple tax engagements efficiently. Stay updated on changes in U.S. federal and state tax laws. 
 Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelors or masters degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field. 2 - 10 years of relevant U.S. tax experience in a CPA firm, accounting firm, or tax preparation environment. Strong experience with U.S. individual and/or business tax returns. Good understanding of U.S. federal and state taxation. Experience with U.S. tax software such as Pro Series or similar platforms is preferred. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting concepts. Ability to understand and analyze financial statements and accounting records. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors or inconsistencies. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work with U.S.-based teams and meet U.S. tax deadlines. 
 Preferred Skills Experience with both individual and business tax returns . Experience with multi-state tax returns. Exposure to partnership, S-corporation, and C-corporation taxation. Knowledge of depreciation, basis calculations, K-1s, Schedule C, Schedule E, Schedule D, and other common U.S. tax schedules. Experience in tax return review and quality control. Prior experience working with a U.S. CPA firm is highly preferred. CPA, EA, or equivalent U.S. tax qualification is a plus but not mandatory. 
 What We Offer Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based CPA firm. Exposure to a wide variety of U.S. tax clients and engagements. Professional growth and opportunities to develop advanced U.S. tax expertise. Collaborative and professional work environment. Competitive compensation based on experience and skills. Opportunity to progress into senior, reviewer, and tax-management roles. 
 Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who has 2 - 10 years of practical U.S. tax experience and a minimum of 5 years of experience in US accounting, can independently prepare U.S. tax returns, understands federal and state tax compliance, pays close attention to detail, and is interested in building a long-term career in U.S. taxation.

Experience: 4-8 Years 
Location: Infopark, Kochi (Work from Office) 
Role Overview 
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Analyst - Identity & Access Management (IAM) to 
support and enhance enterprise identity security, access governance, and privileged access 
management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, 
Active Directory, Hybrid Identity, Identity Governance, and Privileged Access Management 
while ensuring secure and compliant user access across the organization. 
Key Responsibilities 
- Administer and support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid 
identity environments. 
- Manage user lifecycle processes including provisioning, modifications, deprovisioning, 
and access governance. 
- Configure and maintain Microsoft Entra Connect (Azure AD Connect) and hybrid 
identity synchronization. 
- Implement and manage Conditional Access, MFA, Authentication Strength Policies, 
Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). 
- Conduct access reviews, user access recertification, and identity governance activities. 
- Support and maintain SSO integrations using SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and LDAP 
protocols. 
- Implement and manage Just-in-Time (JIT) privileged access and privileged account 
controls. 
- Support PAM integrations and enterprise privileged access solutions. 
- Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, directory synchronization, and identity
related issues. 
- Automate identity administration tasks using PowerShell. 
- Support identity integrations for enterprise applications, VPN/ZTNA solutions, VDI/RDP 
environments, and endpoints. 
- Monitor identity-related security events, audit logs, and SIEM integrations. 
- Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, SOC, PAM, Application, and business teams on 
IAM initiatives. 
- Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, and support 
runbooks. 
- Participate in incident, problem, and change management activities and provide 
escalation/on-call support when required. 
Required Skills & Experience 
- 4+ years of experience in Cybersecurity and Identity & Access Management (IAM). 
- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Hybrid Identity Architecture. 
- Experience managing Active Directory, Group Policies, Users, Groups, and 
Organizational Units (OUs). 
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra Connect (Azure AD Connect). 
- Strong understanding of Identity Governance, Access Reviews, and User Access 
Recertification. 
- Experience with PIM, JIT Access, and privileged identity controls. 
- Knowledge of authentication and identity technologies including SAML, OAuth, OpenID 
Connect (OIDC), LDAP, and Federation Services. 
- Experience onboarding and integrating enterprise applications with Microsoft Entra ID. 
- Knowledge of phishing-resistant authentication technologies such as FIDO2, WebAuthn, 
Passkeys, Windows Hello for Business, Certificate-Based Authentication, and Smart 
Cards. 
- Strong troubleshooting skills for identity and access management issues. 
- Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. 
- Knowledge of service accounts, managed identities, gMSA, certificates, and machine 
identity management. 
- Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills. 
Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience with enterprise PAM solutions. 
- Exposure to SIEM platforms and identity security monitoring. 
- Relevant Microsoft security or identity certifications are an added advantage.

Job Title Job Title: Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager Job Summary The Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager is a critical role responsible for managing and resolving high-impact incidents that affect the services and operations of our organization. The individual in this position will be expected to lead and coordinate the response to major incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations and maintaining communication with all stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in IT service management, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to work under pressure. The Major Incident Manager / Outage Manager is a vital role that requires a dedicated professional capable of navigating high-stress situations and delivering results. If you have the experience, skills, and certifications required, and are ready to take on this challenging yet rewarding position, we encourage you to apply. Responsibilities Lead the process of incident management from detection to resolution and post-incident review. Coordinate with IT teams, business units, and external vendors to manage major incidents effectively. Communicate effectively with all levels of management and stakeholders during major incidents. Develop and maintain the Major Incident Management Plan and ensure it is followed during incidents. Conduct post-incident analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences. As a key player in fintech, MobiKwik offers services across digital payments, credit, and investments, with a strong focus on financial inclusion and regulatory governance.  About the Role: 
 This role will be responsible for managing and strengthening the regulatory compliance framework for the NBFC business, ensuring adherence to RBI regulations and other applicable laws. The incumbent will work closely with business, product, risk, and operations teams to ensure all lending products, customer journeys, and processes are compliant with regulatory requirements. The role also includes managing regulatory reporting, audits, and engagement with regulators.

 Reporting & Framework:

 Audits & Regulatory Engagement: 
 - Manage and coordinate RBI inspections, internal audits, and compliance reviews.
 - Liaise with RBI and other regulatory bodies for submissions, clarifications, and compliance matters.
 - Lead regulatory readiness for audits, inspections, circular changes, and enforcement actions.
 Operations & Risk Monitoring: 
 - Monitor and ensure timely resolution of customer grievances as per regulatory timelines.
 - Drive compliance monitoring, risk mitigation, and regulatory change management initiatives.
 - Conduct rigorous testing and assessments to ensure all operational processes remain in full alignment with industry regulations and legal requirements.

 - Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures and prepare comprehensive reports for internal stakeholders and external regulatory bodies.

title: Actuarial Associate Manager
description:
The Role The Actuarial Associate Manager is responsibility to manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial projects across reserving, pricing, capital, risk modelling and financial reporting. The role combines hands-on actuarial expertise with technical review, project management, client engagement and day-to-day guidance of a small team or project workstream. You will apply sound actuarial judgement to data, methods, assumptions, models and conclusions; ensure high-quality and timely delivery; explain findings clearly to clients and senior colleagues; and build team capability through coaching, feedback and knowledge sharing. What You Will Do Actuarial Project Delivery Manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial assignments across P&C reserving, pricing and insurance optimisation, captive capital and Solvency II, risk financing, and financial reporting. Define and manage scope, workplans, timelines, budgets, dependencies and quality checkpoints for small to medium projects or workstreams within larger engagements. Prepare and oversee forward-looking loss forecasts, reserve analyses, capital assessments and other bespoke actuarial models for corporate and captive insurance clients. Interpret model outputs, investigate movements and translate technical results into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Technical Review and Quality Assurance Perform independent technical and editorial review of data, methodologies, assumptions, calculations, models and client deliverables, applying reasonableness checks and actuarial judgement. Ensure work is accurate, reproducible, appropriately documented and compliant with applicable professional, regulatory and internal standards. Resolve routine and moderately complex technical issues using established methods and prior experience, escalating novel or higher-risk matters when appropriate. Maintain clear review evidence and support continuous improvement of templates, controls and quality frameworks. Lead or contribute substantively to client calls, meetings, workshops and presentations, explaining actuarial methods, findings, limitations and recommendations in accessible language. Work collaboratively with colleagues across geographies and disciplines, coordinating inputs and ensuring effective information exchange. Team Leadership and Capability Building Coordinate the daily activities of analysts and senior analysts on assigned engagements, allocate work and monitor progress against agreed plans. Coach colleagues, answer technical queries and provide timely, constructive feedback that improves actuarial judgement, communication and delivery quality. Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute to a cooperative, inclusive environment that encourages technical development and shared learning. Support resource planning, workload prioritisation, onboarding and development discussions for the immediate team. Core Areas of Work Area / Typical responsibilities P&C Pricing and Optimisation - Loss forecasting, insurance programme analysis, risk transfer optimisation and strategic recommendations. P&C Reserving - Reserving analysis, movement investigation, methods and assumptions, report writing and clear presentation of conclusions. Capital and Solvency II - Profitability and financial strength assessment for captives, review of SCR and technical provisions, assumption challenge and regulatory support. Bespoke Analytics -Risk financing, modelling tools, scenario analysis, automation, research and multidisciplinary risk projects. Experience and Qualifications Recognised degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering or another highly numerate discipline. A minimum of 8 out of 13 actuarial examinations completed toward a recognised actuarial qualification. At least 5 years of relevant actuarial experience, including experience in one or more of P&C reserving, pricing, capital, risk financing, captive insurance or financial reporting. Experience managing project delivery or workstreams, reviewing actuarial work and guiding junior colleagues. Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise reports and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Technical Tools Strong Microsoft Office capability is required. Proficiency in at least one relevant analytical or actuarial tool is expected, such as R/R Shiny, Python, Power BI, RADAR, Igloo or ResQ. The successful candidate should be able to select fit-for-purpose tools, review outputs critically and support reproducible analysis. This description outlines the principal responsibilities of the role. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, client demand and the development of the successful candidate.

Key Skills: Actuarial,Capability Building,Power BI,Technical Review,Project Delivery,Team Leadership,P&C reserving,Quality Assurance

description:
Role Summary We are looking for a customer-focused and energetic Customer Delight Manager to manage and enhance the overall customer experience across our two-wheeler showroom. The role will be responsible for ensuring a smooth and memorable customer journeyfrom showroom enquiry and vehicle purchase through delivery, service follow-up, feedback, and customer retention. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a customer-first attitude, and experience in automobile dealerships, retail, hospitality, banking, or other customer-facing industries . Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Experience Management Own the end-to-end customer experience at the showroom. Ensure customers receive a warm, professional, and consistent experience at every touchpoint. Monitor customer interactions with Sales, Finance, Insurance, Accessories, Delivery, and Service teams. Identify gaps in the customer journey and implement corrective actions. Ensure showroom customer-handling standards are consistently followed. 2. Customer Feedback & Satisfaction Collect and analyse customer feedback through calls, surveys, reviews, and direct interactions. Monitor customer satisfaction scores, NPS/CSI, Google reviews, and other dealership feedback metrics. Identify recurring customer concerns and coordinate with relevant departments for resolution. Develop action plans to improve customer satisfaction and loyalty. Ensure positive customer experiences are encouraged and recognised. 3. Complaint & Escalation Management Act as the primary point of contact for escalated customer complaints. Resolve customer issues promptly and professionally. Coordinate with Sales, Service, Finance, Insurance, and OEM teams to close complaints. Maintain a complaint tracker and ensure timely closure. Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring complaints and recommend preventive actions. Escalate critical issues to senior management with appropriate recommendations. 4. Vehicle Delivery Experience Ensure every vehicle delivery provides a memorable customer experience. Coordinate with Sales and Delivery teams to ensure vehicles are ready on time. Ensure proper documentation, vehicle explanation, accessories, and delivery protocols are completed. Drive personalised delivery experiences for important customers. Monitor delivery feedback and identify areas for improvement. 5. Customer Retention & Relationship Management Develop initiatives to improve customer retention and repeat business. Maintain regular communication with existing customers. Coordinate customer engagement activities, campaigns, events, and referral programmes. Identify opportunities for repeat purchases, accessories, service visits, and referrals. Build strong relationships with key and loyal customers. 6. Digital Reputation Management Monitor customer reviews and feedback across Google and relevant digital platforms. Coordinate appropriate responses to customer reviews in line with company guidelines. Encourage satisfied customers to share genuine feedback and reviews. Track online sentiment and highlight recurring concerns to management. 7. Team Coordination & Training Train showroom employees on customer service etiquette and customer-handling standards. Conduct regular customer experience briefings with Sales and Service teams. Coach employees on communication, complaint handling, and professional behaviour. Work with department heads to improve customer-facing processes. Conduct periodic audits of showroom customer experience. 8. Customer Experience MIS & Reporting Prepare regular reports covering: Customer satisfaction / CSI / NPS Number and type of complaints Complaint closure TAT Customer feedback Delivery experience scores Google/digital reviews Repeat customers Referral leads Customer retention Escalated cases Department-wise customer experience performance Present key findings and improvement plans to management. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Customer Satisfaction / CSI score NPS score and improvement Complaint closure within defined TAT Reduction in repeat complaints Customer retention rate Positive online reviews Customer referral generation Delivery experience rating Customer feedback response rate Successful implementation of customer experience initiatives Candidate Profile Education: Any Bachelor's degree. MBA/PGDM in Marketing, HR, Hospitality, or related areas will be an advantage. Experience: 3–6 years of experience in customer experience, customer relationship management, showroom operations, automobile dealerships, hospitality, retail, banking, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience in a two-wheeler or four-wheeler dealership will be preferred. Candidates with experience handling customer complaints and escalations will be strongly preferred. Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong customer-handling and interpersonal skills Good negotiation and conflict-resolution ability Strong follow-up and coordination skills Problem-solving mindset Ability to handle difficult or dissatisfied customers calmly Good knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint Ability to analyse customer feedback and prepare MIS reports Strong presentation and training skills Professional appearance and positive attitude Tamil and English communication skills are essential; Hindi will be an added advantage Personal Attributes Customer-first mindset Empathy and patience High energy and enthusiasm Ownership and accountability Positive and approachable personality Strong attention to detail Ability to work under pressure Strong relationship-building skills Preferred Industry Background Candidates from the following industries may be considered: Two-wheeler / four-wheeler dealerships Automobile retail Automotive service Retail Hospitality Banking / financial services Consumer durables Premium retail Customer experience / CRM Working Environment The role is primarily showroom-based and requires regular interaction with customers and dealership teams.
