title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
WE ARE HIRING FOR Customer Relationship Manager Location: Chennai | Experience: 7-10 Years About Matrix Business Services Matrix Business Services is one of Indias leading business assurance and risk management companies, helping organizations mitigate risk, strengthen compliance, and make informed business decisions through data-driven verification and assurance services. For over two decades, Matrix has partnered with enterprises across IT/ITES, BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, Telecom, Logistics, and other sectors, delivering solutions spanning Background Verification, Due Diligence, Business Intelligence, Credentialing, Audit & Assurance, Fraud Risk Management, and Compliance Services. Background Verification is one of Matrixs flagship service offerings. Matrix screens over 576,000 candidates annually and works with 700 organizations, combining deep domain expertise, technology, and structured verification processes to help organizations reduce hiring risk and build trusted workforces. The Role We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Customer Relationship Manager to build and strengthen enterprise relationships, drive account growth, and generate new business opportunities for Matrix. The ideal candidate will bring strong industry relationships, relevant Background Verification experience, and a proven ability to convert market connects into tangible business. This is a relationship-led, revenue-focused role for someone who understands the BGV ecosystem, knows the key decision-makers, and can leverage an established network to open doors, create opportunities, and grow Matrix’s client base. Key Responsibilities 1. Client Relationship & Business Growth Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective enterprise clients. Leverage industry relationships and professional networks to generate qualified business opportunities. Identify opportunities for account expansion, cross-selling, upselling, and long-term revenue growth. Act as a trusted advisor to clients by understanding their workforce screening and risk-management requirements. 2. New Business Development Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients across target industries and enterprise segments. Develop and manage a healthy pipeline through referrals, industry connects, networking, market mapping, and proactive outreach. Own the sales cycle from initial introduction and discovery through proposal, negotiation, closure, and handover. Drive business development across Matrix’s Background Verification and related business assurance solutions. 3. Consultative Selling & Solutioning Understand client requirements around employee screening, onboarding, compliance, risk, and workforce verification. Position Matrix’s solutions through consultative, value-based selling and develop relevant business cases. Lead client meetings, presentations, solution discussions, proposals, and commercial negotiations. Coordinate with internal teams to develop solutions that meet client requirements and service expectations. 4. Account Management & Stakeholder Engagement Engage senior stakeholders including CHROs, HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Leaders, Compliance Heads, Procurement teams, and CXO-level decision-makers. Build multi-level relationships within key accounts to strengthen client engagement and retention. Ensure smooth transition of new accounts and work closely with delivery teams to support a strong client experience. Capture customer and market insights and share relevant feedback with internal stakeholders. 5. Sales Execution & Revenue Management Maintain strong pipeline discipline and provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates. Track opportunities, conversion, revenue performance, and account potential. Develop account plans and contribute to market expansion and go-to-market initiatives. Consistently work towards and exceed agreed business and revenue targets. Qualifications & Experience 7–10 years of experience in Client Relationship Management, Business Development, Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, or Strategic Partnerships. Relevant experience in Background Verification / Employee Screening is strongly preferred. Established relationships and industry connects within HR, Talent Acquisition, Staffing, IT/ITES, BFSI, GCCs, or enterprise organizations will be a strong advantage. Proven ability to generate business through an existing network and convert relationships into revenue. Strong track record of client acquisition, account growth, and achievement of business targets. Experience engaging senior stakeholders and managing complex B2B sales cycles. Key Skills Background Verification / Employee Screening Enterprise B2B Sales & Business Development Client & Key Account Management Strategic Partnerships & Industry Networking Consultative & Value-Based Selling Revenue Growth & Account Expansion CXO & Senior Stakeholder Engagement Lead Generation & Prospecting Pipeline Management & Revenue Forecasting Proposal Development & Commercial Negotiation Market Development & GTM Execution Relationship Building & Customer Retention Competitive Intelligence & Business Analysis Cross-functional Collaboration Strong Communication, Presentation & Negotiation What We’re Looking For Strong industry network with the ability to open doors and create new business opportunities. Existing relationships with HR, TA, Staffing, Compliance, Procurement, or business decision-makers will be highly valued. Commercially sharp, target-oriented, and confident in owning revenue outcomes. Strong relationship builder who can convert trust and market connects into long-term business. Structured, disciplined, and proactive approach to sales and client management. High ownership, resilience, and a strong customer-centric mindset. Why Join Us Opportunity to work with a trusted and established player in India’s business assurance and Background Verification ecosystem. Work with enterprise clients across diverse and high-growth industries. High-ownership role with direct impact on client acquisition and revenue growth. Opportunity to leverage and expand your industry network while building a strong career in enterprise business development.

title: Digital Customer Service Manager
description:
Job Description: Digital Customer Service Manager - Asset Management
 
 Role Summary 
The Digital Customer Service Manager is responsible for managing and enhancing digital investor servicing experiences across online and assisteddigital channels for an Asset Management Company (AMC). The role focuses on investor satisfaction, service quality, digital adoption, regulatory compliance , and close coordination with operations, technology, RTA, and distributor ecosystems.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Digital Investor Service Operations 
 Own endtoend digital servicing for investors and distributors across: AMC website and investor portals Mobile applications Email, chat, chatbots, and digital service requests Ensure timely resolution of investor queries related to: Transactions (purchase, redemption, SIP, SWP, STP) Account statements, capital gain statements KYC, FATCA, nomination, bank mandate changes Monitor and manage service SLAs, TATs, and quality standards. Ensure consistency of service across digital and assisted channels (contact center, branches, RTAs). 
 2. Investor Experience & Journey Optimization 
 Design, monitor, and continuously improve digital investor journeys across the investment lifecycle. Identify common investor pain points, repeat service requests, and digital dropoffs. Drive initiatives to: Increase selfservice adoption Reduce manual and assisted requests Improve ease of investing and servicing digitally Track and improve investor satisfaction metrics such as NPS, CSAT, and complaint ratios. 
 3. Digital Platforms, Automation & RTA Coordination 
 Work closely with: Call center Team Internal digital and IT teams RTAs (e.g. CAMS) Technology and service vendors Define business and service requirements for: Digital service enhancements Chatbots, automation, and workflow tools Participate in UAT, releases, and postdeployment monitoring for digital changes. Ensure seamless integration and handoffs between AMC systems and RTA platforms. 
 4. Complaint, Escalation & Regulatory Management 
 Oversee handling of digital servicerelated complaints and escalations. Ensure timely and compliant resolution of: Investor grievances SEBI SCORESrelated complaints Senior management and ombudsman escalations Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions for repeat issues. Ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and investors where required.

description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the worlds largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. 
 Job Description 
 SC2 - Operations Financial Services Operations Representative Training will be for the first 4-6 weeks Monday - Friday 8am to 5pm EST (7am-4pm CST) with mandatory attendance to ensure you receive the best support and education to prepare you for your new role. Role Overview As a Financial Services Operations Representative, you will be providing transaction-processing services with a service orientated approach for our Mutual Fund client. You will work as part of a team to provide proactive and innovative solutions with a high attention to detail and accuracy. This role will be primarily operational in nature; however, you will also have opportunity to interact with account holders while working to research and resolve open items. Our team members share a commitment to ongoing professional development and delivery of exceptional quality service. What you will be doing Perform daily account activities to provide excellent service to our customers by processing financial service requests with efficiency and accuracy. After attending formal training, execute service requests, which include purchases, redemptions, account maintenance, and new account set-up. Meet and surpass quality and productivity objectives within current role, bringing a quality mindset to all aspects of the work. Review transactions for quality, ensuring the accuracy of the work entered; escalating areas of concern as needed. Work collaboratively within a virtual environment to build and maintain strong relationships both internally and externally. On a daily basis, effectively communicate with advisors, shareholders, and the client over the phone in order to resolve complex issues or clarify incoming requests. Utilize internal and external resources to maintain a working knowledge of relevant account and industry trends. Reps II and III will be reviewing and ensuring accuracy of work entered, providing coaching when needed and making recommendations for procedural changes. What You Will Bring Critical thinking skills with the ability to review and analyze information from multiple resources to make an educated decision; strong problem solving and resolution skills. Service related skill set with ability to maintain a strong attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, remain adaptable and flexible with change. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated computer skills with the ability to navigate and toggle between multiple programs and internal resources simultaneously to perform daily functions. Self-motivation with demonstrated ability to work and collaborate in a virtual environment. Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. Position Overview We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented professional to lead Accounts Receivable (AR) training operations, supporting the development and performance of a large trainee cohort. This role is responsible for delivering structured, high-quality training across key AR domains, including Cash Application, Collections, Billing, DD Run, RDD, Write-offs, Order Management, and Customer Master Setup, while ensuring adherence to defined processes, documentation standards, and performance benchmarks. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Manage a large group of trainees, ensuring high-quality end-to-end Accounts Receivable (AR) training. Track and monitor process performance according to a structured training curriculum. Maintain standardized process documentation and obtain timely approvals for updates. Lead the team by setting clear goals, establishing performance review mechanisms, and driving these processes efficiently. Generate career progression opportunities and ensure adequate team backup. Act as a process SME whenever required during periods when no training sessions are scheduled. Oversee task and team management, including training and performance reviews. title: Order Processing Executive
description:
Job Title Order Processing Executive Department Order Processing & Client Operations Employment Type Full-Time, Outsourced (Freshers Welcome) Client Industry Glass Manufacturing (US-Based) Work Shift US Shift, 8:00 PM 4:00 AM | Saturday & Sunday Off Holidays As per the US holiday calendar Compensation Attractive package, based on skills, experience & performance Job Summary The Order Processing Executive is responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of customer orders for our US-based glass manufacturing client — from initial order receipt through accurate data entry, processing, and final hand-off to the fabrication team. This role sits at the center of daily operations, coordinating closely with the CAD/hardware, route planning, and quality control teams to ensure every order moves through the pipeline accurately and on time. The role is well suited to freshers, and full training on internal systems and processes will be provided. Key Responsibilities Receive incoming customer orders and accurately enter all order details, glass specifications, and customer information into internal order management systems. Manage the end-to-end order processing workflow — from order intake to final hand-off for fabrication. Review orders for completeness and accuracy, and follow up with the relevant team or the US client to resolve missing or unclear information. Coordinate daily with the CAD/hardware processing, route planning, and QC teams to keep orders moving smoothly through each stage without delays. Maintain organized, up-to-date records of all processed orders for easy tracking and reference. Communicate order status, clarifications, and updates with the US-based client team as needed. Support process improvements by flagging recurring issues or bottlenecks in the order workflow. Required Skills & Qualifications Basic to intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal) — required for regular interaction with the US client team. Strong attention to detail and comfort with high-volume, repetitive data entry work. Basic computer literacy, including comfort with spreadsheets, email, and standard office software. Ability to follow structured processes and maintain accuracy under daily deadlines. Good organizational skills and reliability in a remote, shift-based work environment. Freshers are welcome to apply — no prior experience is mandatory. Preferred (Not Required) Prior experience in data entry, order processing, back-office support, or a similar administrative role. Familiarity with order management or ERP-style systems. Prior experience working night shifts or with a US-based client/company. Growth & Learning Opportunities This role offers a good-to-great learning path for freshers, with hands-on exposure to real US client operations, cross-functional coordination with CAD, routing, and QC teams, and the opportunity to grow into more senior order operations or team-lead responsibilities as skills and performance develop. Work Schedule Details Shift Timing: 8:00 PM – 4:00 AM (US shift). Week Off: Saturday and Sunday. Holidays: Aligned with the US holiday calendar, as followed by the client.
